title.en: Volume 57 Treatises 32: Geography 4, Hei Long Jiang
title.raw: 卷57 志三十二 地理四 黑龙江

sentences.zh: 志三十二

translations.literal: Treatise 32
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 32

sentences.zh: 地理四

translations.literal: Geography 4
translations.idiomatic: Geography 4

sentences.zh: 黑龍江：古肅慎國北境。

translations.literal: Heilongjiang: the northern borderland of the ancient Sushen state.
translations.idiomatic: Heilongjiang: the northern frontier of the ancient Sushen kingdom.

sentences.zh: 明領於奴兒干都司。

translations.literal: Under the Ming, it was administered by the Nue'ergan Military Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming dynasty, it fell under the jurisdiction of the Nue'ergan Military Commission.

sentences.zh: 清初有索倫、達呼爾諸部，散居黑龍江內外額爾古納河及精奇里江之地。

translations.literal: In the early Qing, the Solon, Daur, and other tribes were scattered throughout the lands on both sides of the Heilongjiang, along the Argun River and the Shilka River.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Qing, the Solon, Daur, and other tribes were dispersed across the Heilongjiang region, on both banks of the river and along the Argun and Shilka rivers.

sentences.zh: 天聰、崇德中，次第征服。

translations.literal: During the Tiancong and Chongde reigns, they were conquered in succession.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tiancong and Chongde reigns, these peoples were brought under Qing control one after another.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十二年征羅剎，始設鎮守黑龍江等處將軍及副都統駐江東岸之愛渾城，尋並移駐墨爾根。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year of Kangxi, when campaigns were launched against the Russians, a General of Garrison Troops for Heilongjiang and other regions was first established, with a deputy commander stationed at Aihun on the east bank of the river; both were soon relocated to Mergen.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year of Kangxi, during the campaigns against the Russians, the Qing first established a General of Garrison Troops for Heilongjiang and other regions, with a deputy commander garrisoned at Aihun on the river's east bank; both posts were soon transferred to Mergen.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，副都統移駐齊齊哈爾。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year, the deputy commander was transferred to Qiqihar.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-seventh year, the deputy commander was relocated to Qiqihar.

sentences.zh: 三十八年，將軍亦移駐，遂為省治。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year, the general was also transferred there, and it became the provincial seat.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-eighth year, the general was transferred there as well, and Qiqihar became the provincial capital.

sentences.zh: 後增設墨爾根、黑龍江、呼蘭、呼倫貝爾、布特哈各副都統。

translations.literal: Later, deputy commanders were added at Mergen, Heilongjiang, Hulan, Hulun Buir, and Buteha.
translations.idiomatic: Subsequently, additional deputy commanders were established at Mergen, Heilongjiang, Hulan, Hulun Buir, and Buteha.

sentences.zh: 光緒末，裁省其半，改置廳、府、縣有差。

translations.literal: At the end of the Guangxu reign, half of these posts were abolished, and subprefectures, prefectures, and counties were established in varying numbers.
translations.idiomatic: In the late Guangxu period, half of these posts were abolished and replaced with a mix of subprefectures, prefectures, and counties.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，罷將軍，設黑龍江巡撫，改為行省，悉裁副都統各缺，變置地方官制。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year, the general was abolished, a Heilongjiang governor was appointed, the region was converted to a province, all deputy commander posts were abolished, and the local administrative system was reorganized.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year, the general's post was abolished and a Heilongjiang governor was appointed; the region was reorganized as a province, all deputy commander positions were eliminated, and a new local administrative structure was put in place.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年，為道三，府七，廳六，州一，縣七。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xuantong, there were three circuit intendancies, seven prefectures, six subprefectures, one department, and seven counties.
translations.idiomatic: By the third year of the Xuantong reign, the province comprised three circuit intendancies, seven prefectures, six subprefectures, one department, and seven counties.

sentences.zh: 擬設之府一，直隸廳十一，縣五。

translations.literal: One prefecture, eleven directly administered subprefectures, and five counties were planned for establishment.
translations.idiomatic: Plans called for one additional prefecture, eleven directly administered subprefectures, and five counties.

sentences.zh: 南至松花江與吉林界，西至額爾古訥河與俄領薩拜哈勒省及外蒙古車臣汗旗界，西南接內蒙古之烏珠穆沁左翼、科爾沁右翼中、前、後各旗界，東至松花、黑龍兩江合流處，仍界吉林，北及東北皆與俄領阿穆爾省界。

translations.literal: Its southern border with Jilin was the Songhua River; its western border with Russian Sabkhal Province and the Outer Mongolian Tsetsen Khan Banner was the Argun River; to the southwest it adjoined the Left Wing Ujimchin Banner and the Middle, Front, and Rear Banners of the Right Wing Khorchin in Inner Mongolia; to the east it reached the confluence of the Songhua and Heilong rivers, where the border with Jilin continued; to the north and northeast it bordered Russian Amur Province.
translations.idiomatic: It bordered Jilin to the south along the Songhua River; to the west, the Argun River marked the boundary with Russian Sabkhal Province and the Outer Mongolian Tsetsen Khan Banner; to the southwest it adjoined the Left Wing Ujimchin Banner and the Middle, Front, and Rear Banners of the Right Wing Khorchin in Inner Mongolia; to the east it extended to the confluence of the Songhua and Heilong rivers, still bordering Jilin; and to the north and northeast it bordered Russian Amur Province.

sentences.zh: 廣二千八百餘里，袤一千五百餘里。

translations.literal: Its width was more than 2,800 li, and its length more than 1,500 li.
translations.idiomatic: It measured over 2,800 li from east to west and over 1,500 li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 北極高四十五度五十分至五十二度五十分。

translations.literal: Its northern latitude ranged from 45 degrees 50 minutes to 52 degrees 50 minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Its latitude ranged from 45°50′ to 52°50′ north.

sentences.zh: 京師偏東三度四十分至十六度二十分。

translations.literal: It lay 3 degrees 40 minutes to 16 degrees 20 minutes east of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: It lay between 3°40′ and 16°20′ east of the capital.

sentences.zh: 案黑龍江舊界，楊賓柳邊紀略云：「艾渾將軍所屬，東至海，西至你不楮俄羅斯界。」

translations.literal: Regarding the old borders of Heilongjiang, Yang Bin's Notes on the Willow Palisade states: 'The territory under the Aihun General extended east to the sea and west to the Russian border at Nibuchu.'
translations.idiomatic: On the old borders of Heilongjiang, Yang Bin's Notes on the Willow Palisade records: 'The territory under the Aihun General extended east to the sea and west to the Russian border at Nibuchu.'

sentences.zh: 你不楮即尼布楚，今俄名捏爾臣斯克。

translations.literal: Nibuchu is Nerchinsk, now called Nerchinsk in Russian.
translations.idiomatic: Nibuchu is Nerchinsk, known in Russian as Nerchinsk.

sentences.zh: 艾渾將軍即黑龍江將軍，此清初界也。

translations.literal: The Aihun General was the Heilongjiang General; this was the early Qing border.
translations.idiomatic: The Aihun General was the Heilongjiang General — this was the border as it stood in the early Qing.

sentences.zh: 自安巴格爾必齊河口，即循此河上流之外興安嶺，東至於海。

translations.literal: From the mouth of the Amba Garganchi River, following the upper course of this river along the Outer Khingan Range, east to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: From the mouth of the Amba Garganchi River, the border followed the upper course of that river along the Outer Khingan Range eastward to the sea.

sentences.zh: 凡嶺以南，流入黑龍江之溪河屬中國，嶺以北屬俄羅斯。

translations.literal: All streams and rivers south of the range that flowed into the Heilongjiang belonged to China; those north of the range belonged to Russia.
translations.idiomatic: All streams and rivers south of the range that drained into the Heilongjiang belonged to China; those north of the range belonged to Russia.

sentences.zh: 中、俄分嶺，此康熙二十八年尼布楚條約界也。

translations.literal: China and Russia were divided by the mountain range; this was the border established by the Nerchinsk Treaty of the twenty-eighth year of Kangxi.
translations.idiomatic: China and Russia were divided along the mountain range — the boundary set by the Nerchinsk Treaty of Kangxi 28.

sentences.zh: 自額爾古訥河入黑龍江處起，至黑龍江與松花江會流處止，以南以西屬黑龍江省，以北以東屬俄羅斯，中、俄分江，此咸豐八年璦琿條約界也。

translations.literal: From where the Argun River enters the Heilongjiang to where the Heilongjiang joins the Songhua River, the area south and west belonged to Heilongjiang Province and the area north and east belonged to Russia; China and Russia were divided by the river — this was the border established by the Aigun Treaty of the eighth year of Xianfeng.
translations.idiomatic: From the point where the Argun River enters the Heilongjiang to the confluence of the Heilongjiang and Songhua rivers, the territory south and west of the river belonged to Heilongjiang Province and the territory north and east belonged to Russia — the boundary set by the Aigun Treaty of Xianfeng 8.

sentences.zh: 尼布楚在安巴格爾必齊河西五百餘里，本中國茂明安、布拉特、烏梁海諸部落地。

translations.literal: Nerchinsk lay more than 500 li west of the Amba Garganchi River; it was originally the territory of the Chinese Maoming'an, Buryat, and Uriankhai tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Nerchinsk lay more than 500 li west of the Amba Garganchi River, on land that had originally belonged to the Maoming'an, Buryat, and Uriankhai tribes under Chinese jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 崇德中，即為俄羅斯人竊據，築城居之，以侵掠索倫、達呼爾諸部，為邊患者三十餘年。

translations.literal: During the Chongde reign, Russians seized it by stealth, built a fort, and settled there, raiding the Solon, Daur, and other tribes and causing border troubles for more than thirty years.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chongde reign, Russians seized the area, built a fort, and settled there, raiding the Solon, Daur, and other tribes and troubling the frontier for more than thirty years.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十八年定界，遂捐以畀俄，已蹙舊界地五百餘里矣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year of Kangxi, when the border was fixed, it was ceded to Russia, already shrinking the old borderland by more than 500 li.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year of Kangxi, when the boundary was fixed, the territory was ceded to Russia, already reducing the old frontier by more than 500 li.

sentences.zh: 若外興安嶺以南，黑龍江以北以東舊界地，殆三千七百里有奇，其境內山川、部落、城屯雖為俄有，亦並志之，不忘其朔焉。

translations.literal: As for the old borderland south of the Outer Khingan Range and north and east of the Heilongjiang, it amounted to roughly 3,700 li; although its mountains, rivers, tribes, and fortified settlements now belong to Russia, they are also recorded here, so that their origins are not forgotten.
translations.idiomatic: The old borderland south of the Outer Khingan Range and north and east of the Heilongjiang amounted to roughly 3,700 li; although its mountains, rivers, tribes, and fortified settlements now belong to Russia, they are recorded here as well, so that their origins are not forgotten.

sentences.zh: 外興安嶺為崑崙北出之大幹。

translations.literal: The Outer Khingan Range is the northern branch of the Kunlun Range.
translations.idiomatic: The Outer Khingan Range is the northern branch of the Kunlun mountain system.

sentences.zh: 蓋崑崙山脈南幹，為涼州南山，為賀蘭山，為陰山，為內興安嶺。

translations.literal: The southern branch of the Kunlun Range becomes the Southern Mountains of Liangzhou, the Helan Mountains, the Yin Mountains, and the Inner Khingan Range.
translations.idiomatic: The southern branch of the Kunlun Range runs through the Southern Mountains of Liangzhou, the Helan Mountains, the Yin Mountains, and the Inner Khingan Range.

sentences.zh: 北幹為蔥嶺，為天山，為阿爾泰山，為墾特山，為外興安嶺。

translations.literal: The northern branch becomes the Pamir, the Tianshan, the Altai, the Kent Mountains, and the Outer Khingan Range.
translations.idiomatic: The northern branch runs through the Pamir, the Tianshan, the Altai, the Kent Mountains, and the Outer Khingan Range.

sentences.zh: 內外者，據黑龍江言之。

translations.literal: 'Inner' and 'outer' are defined with reference to the Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: The terms 'inner' and 'outer' are defined with reference to the Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 餘若斗色山、若楊山、若珠德赫山、若訥丹哈達拉山、若達勒替沙山、若阿喇拉山、若道斯哈達、若察哈彥哈達、若茂哈達，皆外興安嶺支絡，並在江東北。

translations.literal: Others such as Mount Douse, Mount Yang, Mount Zhudehe, Mount Nedan Hadala, Mount Daleti Sha, Mount Alala, Daos Had, Chahayan Had, and Mao Had are all spurs of the Outer Khingan Range, all located northeast of the river.
translations.idiomatic: Other peaks — Mount Douse, Mount Yang, Mount Zhudehe, Mount Nedan Hadala, Mount Daleti Sha, Mount Alala, Daos Had, Chahayan Had, and Mao Had — are all spurs of the Outer Khingan Range, lying northeast of the river.

sentences.zh: 水以安巴格爾必齊河為康熙舊界入江之始。

translations.literal: Among the waterways, the Amba Garganchi River marks where the old Kangxi border first enters the river.
translations.idiomatic: Of the waterways, the Amba Garganchi River marks the point where the old Kangxi border first meets the Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 由此而東，曰卓魯克齊河、曰烏魯穆河、曰格爾必齊河、曰呼吉河、曰張他拉河、曰鄂爾多昆河、曰烏爾蘇河、曰波羅穆達河、曰額爾格河、曰巴爾坦河，又東少南，曰託羅河、曰臥諾河、曰巴里彥河、曰阿蘇河、曰淘斯河、曰凱蘭河、曰阿喇拉河、曰大蘭河、曰庫哷恩河、曰額蘇里河、曰多普塔拉河。

translations.literal: From here eastward are the Zhuoluoqi, Ulumu, Garganchi, Huji, Zhangtala, Ordokun, Wursu, Bolomuda, Erge, and Baitan rivers; farther east and slightly south are the Tuoluo, Wono, Baliyan, Asu, Taosi, Kailan, Alala, Dalan, Kuleen, Esuri, and Duoputala rivers.
translations.idiomatic: From this point eastward lie the Zhuoluoqi, Ulumu, Garganchi, Huji, Zhangtala, Ordokun, Wursu, Bolomuda, Erge, and Baitan rivers; farther east and slightly south are the Tuoluo, Wono, Baliyan, Asu, Taosi, Kailan, Alala, Dalan, Kuleen, Esuri, and Duoputala rivers.

sentences.zh: 又南曰精奇里江，為諸河最，源出外興安嶺極北之地，東南流，轉西南流，江形如弓。

translations.literal: Farther south is the Shilka River, the greatest of these rivers; it rises in the far north of the Outer Khingan Range, flows southeast, then turns southwest, and the river's course is shaped like a bow.
translations.idiomatic: Farther south is the Shilka River, the largest of these waterways; it rises in the far north of the Outer Khingan Range, flows southeast, then turns southwest in a bow-shaped course.

sentences.zh: 有烏爾格河、託克吉魯河、烏爾替河、克德畢河，自西北來注之。

translations.literal: The Urge, Tokjilu, Wurti, and Kede Bi rivers join it from the northwest.
translations.idiomatic: The Urge, Tokjilu, Wurti, and Kede Bi rivers join it from the northwest.

sentences.zh: 有阿爾吉河、巴里木河、塔烏爾堪河、畢奇勒圖河、欽都河、寧尼河、額勒格河、牒葉普河、鐵牛河、西里木迪河、察勒布克爾河、英肯河、們臥勒河、莫昆河、巴沙河、楊奇尼河、密奇訥河、翁額納拉河、巴里木邁庫里河、託莫臥河、伊羅河、昆貝河、屯布河、迪音河，自東北來注之。

translations.literal: The Arji, Balimu, Tawurkan, Biqiltu, Qindu, Ningni, Elege, Dieyepu, Tieniu, Xilimudi, Chalebuker, Yingken, Menwole, Mokun, Basha, Yangqini, Miqi'ne, Weng'enala, Balimu Maikuli, Tuomowo, Yiluo, Kunbei, Tunbu, and Diyin rivers join it from the northeast.
translations.idiomatic: The Arji, Balimu, Tawurkan, Biqiltu, Qindu, Ningni, Elege, Dieyepu, Tieniu, Xilimudi, Chalebuker, Yingken, Menwole, Mokun, Basha, Yangqini, Miqi'ne, Weng'enala, Balimu Maikuli, Tuomowo, Yiluo, Kunbei, Tunbu, and Diyin rivers join it from the northeast.

sentences.zh: 黑龍江水色微黑，精奇里江獨黃，又稱黃河。

translations.literal: The waters of the Heilongjiang are slightly dark; the Shilka River alone is yellow, and is also called the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: The Heilongjiang's waters are slightly dark, but the Shilka alone runs yellow and is also known as the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 又南而東，曰謨里爾克河、曰博屯河。

translations.literal: Farther south and east are the Molierke and Botun rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Farther south and east lie the Molierke and Botun rivers.

sentences.zh: 又南而東，曰牛滿河，源出外興安嶺，嶺東舊界吉林。

translations.literal: Farther south and east is the Niuman River, which rises in the Outer Khingan Range; east of the range was the old border with Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: Farther south and east is the Niuman River, which rises in the Outer Khingan Range; east of the range lay the old border with Jilin.

sentences.zh: 西南流，東合烏旺那河、烏莫勒德河、攸瓦爾奇河、敖拉河、塔拉耐河、塔里木河、薩公那河、吉克河，西合臥爾喜河、卓羅奇河、木爾木河、楊奇里河、珠奇河、寧那河、伊莫勒河、楚克河。

translations.literal: It flows southwest; from the east it receives the Uwangna, Wumo'lede, Youwa'erqi, Aola, Talanai, Talimu, Sagongna, and Jike rivers; from the west it receives the Wo'erxi, Zhuoluoqi, Mu'ermu, Yangqili, Zhuqi, Ningna, Yimo'le, and Chuke rivers.
translations.idiomatic: It flows southwest, receiving from the east the Uwangna, Wumo'lede, Youwa'erqi, Aola, Talanai, Talimu, Sagongna, and Jike rivers, and from the west the Wo'erxi, Zhuoluoqi, Mu'ermu, Yangqili, Zhuqi, Ningna, Yimo'le, and Chuke rivers.

sentences.zh: 牛滿河亦稱斗滿河，又南而東，曰哈拉河、曰阿拉河、曰塔拉木河、曰庫勒圖爾河、曰庫木弩河、曰珠春河、曰格林河、曰胡裕魯河、曰蘇魯河、曰伊圖裡河、曰畢占河。

translations.literal: The Niuman River is also called the Douman River; farther south and east are the Hala, Ala, Talamu, Kuletu'er, Kumunu, Zhuchun, Gelin, Huyu'lu, Sulu, Yitu'li, and Bizhan rivers.
translations.idiomatic: The Niuman River is also known as the Douman River; farther south and east lie the Hala, Ala, Talamu, Kuletu'er, Kumunu, Zhuchun, Gelin, Huyu'lu, Sulu, Yitu'li, and Bizhan rivers.

sentences.zh: 以上諸河，並南入黑龍江。

translations.literal: All the rivers above flow south into the Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: All of these rivers flow south into the Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 畢占河以南，舊為吉林境。

translations.literal: South of the Bizhan River was formerly Jilin territory.
translations.idiomatic: South of the Bizhan River lay what had formerly been Jilin territory.

sentences.zh: 其部落，則精奇里江東西，為索倫部、達呼爾部。

translations.literal: As for the tribes, on both sides of the Shilka River were the Solon and Daur tribes.
translations.idiomatic: The tribes on both sides of the Shilka River were the Solon and Daur.

sentences.zh: 有索倫村，在精奇里江、額爾格河之間，南距黑龍江城五六日程。

translations.literal: There was a Solon village between the Shilka and Erge rivers, five or six days' journey south of Heilongjiang City.
translations.idiomatic: A Solon village lay between the Shilka and Erge rivers, five or six days' journey south of Heilongjiang City.

sentences.zh: 欽都河西及巴爾坦河東，為使鹿鄂倫春部。

translations.literal: West of the Qindu River and east of the Baitan River were the Reindeer-using Oroqen tribe.
translations.idiomatic: West of the Qindu River and east of the Baitan River lived the reindeer-using Oroqen.

sentences.zh: 自額蘇里河口溯江而西，至額爾格河口，為庫爾喀部，其城屯有曰鐸辰城、阿薩津城、多金城、烏魯蘇穆丹城、郭博勒屯、博和哩屯、噶勒達遜屯、穆丹屯、都孫屯、烏爾堪屯、德篤勒屯、額蘇哩屯、額爾圖屯，並在江北岸東岸。

translations.literal: From the mouth of the Esuri River upstream westward to the mouth of the Erge River was the Kurka tribe; its fortified settlements included Duochen City, Asajin City, Duojin City, Wursumudan City, Guobole Station, Boheli Station, Galeda'xun Station, Mudan Station, Dusun Station, Wurkan Station, Dedule Station, Esuli Station, and Ertu Station, all on the north and east banks of the river.
translations.idiomatic: From the mouth of the Esuri River upstream to the mouth of the Erge River lived the Kurka tribe; their fortified settlements included Duochen City, Asajin City, Duojin City, Wursumudan City, and the stations at Guobole, Boheli, Galeda'xun, Mudan, Dusun, Wurkan, Dedule, Esuli, and Ertu — all on the north and east banks of the river.

sentences.zh: 雅克薩城在黑龍江城西北一千三百餘里，城東即提咸河灣城，本索倫部築。

translations.literal: Albazin was more than 1,300 li northwest of Heilongjiang City; east of the city was Tixianhewan City, originally built by the Solon tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Albazin lay more than 1,300 li northwest of Heilongjiang City; east of the city stood Tixianhewan City, originally built by the Solon.

sentences.zh: 嗣因博木博果爾等據城以叛，崇德四年討平之，墟其城。

sentences.zh: 正支又東北，為嫩江源。

translations.idiomatic: Longjiang Prefecture: strategically important, busy, taxing, and difficult to administer.

translations.idiomatic: Formerly known as Zhashugang.

sentences.zh: 柞樹一名青岡柳，縣以此名。

translations.literal: The zha tree is also called the qinggang willow; the county takes its name from this.
translations.idiomatic: The zha tree is also known as the qinggang willow, from which the county takes its name.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十年置，隸廳。

translations.literal: Established in the thirtieth year of Guangxu, subordinate to the subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: It was established in Guangxu 30 and placed under the subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 東：通肯河自拜泉入，南流，與府分界，入呼蘭河。

translations.literal: To the east: the Tongken River enters from Baiquan, flows south, forms the border with the prefecture, and enters the Hulan River.
translations.idiomatic: To the east, the Tongken River enters from Baiquan, flows south along the prefectural border, and joins the Hulan River.

sentences.zh: 呼蘭河自府會通肯河入，西南流，與呼蘭分界，入呼蘭境。

translations.literal: The Hulan River enters where it meets the Tongken River in the prefecture, flows southwest, forms the border with Hulan, and enters Hulan territory.
translations.idiomatic: The Hulan River enters where it joins the Tongken River in the prefecture, flows southwest along the border with Hulan, and enters Hulan territory.

sentences.zh: 官商路四：東北駱家窩棚赴府；

translations.literal: Four official merchant roads: northeast from Luojiawopeng to the prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Four official merchant roads: one northeast from Luojiawopeng to the prefectural seat;

sentences.zh: 西大林家店赴省城；

translations.literal: West from Dalinjia Store to the provincial capital;
translations.idiomatic: One west from Dalinjia Store to the provincial capital;

sentences.zh: 西南白家店至安達；

translations.literal: Southwest from Baijia Store to Anda;
translations.idiomatic: One southwest from Baijia Store to Anda;

sentences.zh: 南李春芳屯達蘭西。

translations.literal: South from Lichunfang Tun to Lanxi.
translations.idiomatic: One south from Lichunfang Tun to Lanxi.

sentences.zh: 又縣南呂馬店、東南何小懷屯，為省城東路站道，由此赴興京。

translations.literal: Also Lüma Store south of the county and Hexiaohuai Tun to the southeast are the eastern-route stations to the provincial capital, from which one travels to Xingjing.
translations.idiomatic: Lüma Store south of the county and Hexiaohuai Tun to the southeast also serve as the eastern-route stations to the provincial capital, from which one proceeds to Xingjing.

sentences.zh: 拜泉縣繁，難。

translations.literal: Baiquan County: busy and difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Baiquan County: busy and difficult to administer.

sentences.zh: 府西北一百六十里。

translations.literal: 160 li northwest of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 160 li northwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 原名巴拜泉，即那吉泊，土名大泡子，縣以此名。

translations.literal: Formerly called Babai Spring, that is Najibo, locally known as Dapaozi; the county takes its name from this.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly called Babai Spring—also known as Najibo and locally as Dapaozi—the county takes its name from this spring.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十二年置，隸廳。

translations.literal: Established in the thirty-second year of Guangxu, subordinate to the subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: It was established in Guangxu 32 and placed under the subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 三十四年改府，仍隸。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year [the subprefecture] was changed to a prefecture; [the county] remained subordinate.
translations.idiomatic: When the subprefecture was elevated to a prefecture in the thirty-fourth year, the county remained under its jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 東：通肯河自府境入，南流，與府分界。

translations.literal: To the east: the Tongken River enters from prefectural territory, flows south, and forms the border with the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: To the east, the Tongken River enters from prefectural territory, flows south, and marks the border with the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 右受七道、六道、五道、四道、三道、二道、頭道溝，入青岡。

translations.literal: It receives on the right the Qidao, Liudao, Wudao, Sidao, Sandao, Erdao, and Toudao gullies, and enters Qinggang.
translations.idiomatic: It receives the Qidao, Liudao, Wudao, Sidao, Sandao, Erdao, and Toudao gullies on the right and flows into Qinggang.

sentences.zh: 北：胡裕爾河自訥河入，受印京河，西入龍江。

translations.literal: To the north: the Huyuer River enters from Nehe, receives the Yinjing River, and flows west into Longjiang.
translations.idiomatic: To the north, the Huyuer River enters from Nehe, receives the Yinjing River, and flows west into Longjiang.

sentences.zh: 南：雙陽河，東逕縣南，又東瀦為松津泊。

translations.literal: To the south: the Shuangyang River flows east past the south of the county, then eastward and pools into Songjin Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: To the south, the Shuangyang River flows east past the south of the county and then pools into Songjin Marsh.

sentences.zh: 巴拜泉在雙陽河南，其東南白水泉。

translations.literal: Babai Spring lies south of the Shuangyang River; to its southeast is Baishui Spring.
translations.idiomatic: Babai Spring lies south of the Shuangyang River, with Baishui Spring to its southeast.

sentences.zh: 西南：馬鞍泊、白華泊，皆平地出泉，可供汲飲，故有巴拜之稱。

translations.literal: To the southwest: Ma'an Marsh and Baihua Marsh both issue springs from level ground and can supply drinking water; hence the name Babai.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest, Ma'an Marsh and Baihua Marsh both issue springs from level ground suitable for drawing drinking water, which gave rise to the name Babai.

sentences.zh: 巴拜即「寶貝」轉音也。

translations.literal: Babai is a transliteration of "treasure."
translations.idiomatic: Babai is a phonetic rendering of the word for "treasure."

sentences.zh: 官商路四：東南三道溝赴府；

translations.literal: Four official merchant roads: southeast from Sandao Gully to the prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Four official merchant roads: one southeast from Sandao Gully to the prefectural seat;

sentences.zh: 東北李喜屯達訥河之三站，即新開海佈道；

translations.literal: Northeast from Lixi Tun to the third station of Nehe, that is, the newly opened Haibu Road;
translations.idiomatic: One northeast from Lixi Tun to the third Nehe station, on the newly opened Haibu Road;

sentences.zh: 西孔家地房赴省城；

translations.literal: West from Kongjia Store to the provincial capital;
translations.idiomatic: One west from Kongjia Store to the provincial capital;

sentences.zh: 南菜富屯至青岡。

translations.literal: South from Caifu Tun to Qinggang.
translations.idiomatic: One south from Caifu Tun to Qinggang.

sentences.zh: 胡裕爾河北岸有莽鼐牧場。

translations.literal: On the north bank of the Huyuer River is the Mangnai pasture.
translations.idiomatic: The Mangnai pasture lies on the north bank of the Huyuer River.

sentences.zh: 有額魯特依克明安公府。

translations.literal: There is the Elute Yikeming'an Duke's residence.
translations.idiomatic: The residence of the Elute Yikeming'an Duke is also located there.

sentences.zh: 嫩江府：省東北四百五十里。

translations.literal: Nenjiang Prefecture: 450 li northeast of the province.
translations.idiomatic: Nenjiang Prefecture lies 450 li northeast of the provincial seat.

sentences.zh: 即墨爾根副都統城。

translations.literal: That is, the Mergen deputy commander's city.
translations.idiomatic: It is the former seat of the Mergen deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 明為木里吉衛，譯即墨爾根。

translations.literal: Under the Ming it was Muliqi Guard, translated as Mergen.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming it was Muliqi Guard, rendered as Mergen.

sentences.zh: 康熙十年，墨爾哲勒氏屯長來歸，編為墨爾根四十佐領，號新滿洲是也。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Kangxi, the village head of the Mo'erzhele clan submitted, was organized as Mergen's forty company commanders, and was called New Manchuria.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 10, the village head of the Mo'erzhele clan submitted to the Qing and was organized as Mergen's forty company commanders, forming what was known as New Manchuria.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十四年，以墨爾根城改置府。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year of Guangxu, a prefecture was established by reorganizing Mergen city.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 34, the prefecture was established by reorganizing the city of Mergen.

sentences.zh: 廣四百餘里，袤六百餘里。

translations.literal: Its width is more than 400 li, and its length more than 600 li.
translations.idiomatic: It measures over 400 li from east to west and over 600 li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 北極高四十九度十三分。

translations.literal: Its northern latitude is 49 degrees 13 minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Its latitude is 49°13′ north.

sentences.zh: 京師偏東八度四十二分。

translations.literal: It lies 8 degrees 42 minutes east of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 8°42′ east of the capital.

sentences.zh: 府境為內興安嶺山脈三面環繞，嫩江縱貫其中，全境東西之水皆入嫩江，江出北伊勒呼里阿林，山脈自西而東橫亙處也。

translations.literal: The prefectural territory is encircled on three sides by the Inner Khingan mountain ranges; the Nen River runs north-south through it; waters throughout the territory east and west all enter the Nen River; the river issues from the northern Yilehuli Mountains where the ranges run east-west across it.
translations.idiomatic: The prefecture is encircled on three sides by the Inner Khingan ranges, with the Nen River running north to south through its center. Waters throughout the territory drain east and west into the Nen River, which rises in the northern Yilehuli Mountains where the ranges run east-west across the land.

sentences.zh: 江以西山之著者，曰莽藍哈達七峰山、庫勒木爾山、穆克珠勒渾山、阿昆迪奇山、阿察特山、噶珊山、博里克山、達克固善山、東曰傅什霍山、伊勒賁孛山、勒吉勒圖山、勒吉爾山、達巴爾山、特克屯山、旺安山、圖墨爾肯山。

translations.literal: Notable mountains west of the river are Manglanhada Qifeng Mountain, Kulemu'er Mountain, Mukuzhulehun Mountain, Akundiqi Mountain, Achate Mountain, Gashan Mountain, Bolike Mountain, and Dakegushan Mountain; to the east are Fushihuo Mountain, Yilebenbo Mountain, Lejiletu Mountain, Leji'er Mountain, Daba'er Mountain, Teketun Mountain, Wang'an Mountain, and Tumuerken Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Notable mountains west of the river include Manglanhada Qifeng, Kulemu'er, Mukuzhulehun, Akundiqi, Achate, Gashan, Bolike, and Dakegushan; to the east are Fushihuo, Yilebenbo, Lejiletu, Leji'er, Daba'er, Teketun, Wang'an, and Tumuerken.

sentences.zh: 嫩江導源東南流，逕格爾布爾山前，左受納約爾河、那昔台河、霍吉格那彥河、額勒和肯河，右受伊斯肯。

translations.literal: The Nen River rises and flows southeast, passes before Mount Ge'erbu'er, receives on the left the Naya'er, Naxitai, Huojigenayan, and E'leheken rivers, and on the right receives the Yiken.
translations.idiomatic: The Nen River rises and flows southeast past Mount Ge'erbu'er, receiving the Naya'er, Naxitai, Huojigenayan, and E'leheken rivers on the left and the Yiken on the right.

sentences.zh: 折南流，左受哈羅爾、阿魯三松哈諾勒、雅普薩台、固巴諸河，右受喀柰、吉里克、喇都里、多布庫爾、歐肯諸河。

translations.literal: It turns south, receives on the left the Haruo'er, Aru Sansong Hanuole, Yapusatai, and Guba rivers, and on the right receives the Kana'i, Jilike, Laduli, Duobuku'er, and Ouken rivers.
translations.idiomatic: It turns south, receiving the Haruo'er, Aru Sansong Hanuole, Yapusatai, and Guba rivers on the left and the Kana'i, Jilike, Laduli, Duobuku'er, and Ouken rivers on the right.

sentences.zh: 又南屈西，江流灣環作二曲，又南謨魯爾河、和羅爾河自東來注之。

translations.literal: Farther south it bends west; the river's course loops in two bends; farther south the Mo'luo'er and Heluo'er rivers join from the east.
translations.idiomatic: Farther south it bends west, the river looping in two great bends, and is joined from the east by the Mo'luo'er and Heluo'er rivers.

sentences.zh: 又南逕府城西，又屈西，甘河自西北來注之，西南入訥河。

translations.literal: Farther south it passes west of the prefectural city, bends west again, is joined from the northwest by the Gan River, and flows southwest into Nehe.
translations.idiomatic: It continues south past the west of the prefectural city, bends west again as the Gan River joins from the northwest, and flows southwest into Nehe.

sentences.zh: 舊設站五：自訥河博爾多站北四十三里至府屬喀木尼喀，又四十二里至依拉喀，又七十里至墨爾根，即府。

translations.literal: Five old relay stations were established: from Nehe Bo'erdozhan north 43 li to Kamunika under the prefecture, then 42 li to Yilaka, then 70 li to Mergen, which is the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Five relay stations were formerly established along this route: from Nehe Bo'erdozhan, 43 li north to Kamunika in the prefecture, then 42 li to Yilaka, then 70 li to Mergen—the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 又東北七十六里至科絡爾，又七十六里至喀勒塔爾奇，又東北接黑龍江城之庫穆爾。

translations.literal: Then northeast 76 li to Keluo'er, then 76 li to Kaleta'erqi, then northeast connecting with Kumur in Heilongjiang city.
translations.idiomatic: From there it runs 76 li northeast to Keluo'er, another 76 li to Kaleta'erqi, and then northeast to Kumur in Heilongjiang city.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，於兩城交界處增設陡溝子文報局。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuantong, a Dougouzi courier dispatch office was added at the junction of the two cities.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 1, a Dougouzi courier dispatch office was established at the boundary between the two cities.

sentences.zh: 又由府北行，沿嫩江東岸，可達呼瑪金廠。

translations.literal: Also from the prefecture northward, along the east bank of the Nen River, one can reach the Huma gold mining district.
translations.idiomatic: From the prefectural seat, one can also travel north along the east bank of the Nen River to the Huma gold mining district.

sentences.zh: 卡倫九：曰諾敏河巴延和羅，曰甘河商河哈達，凡二；

translations.literal: Nine karun outposts: Nuominhe Bayanheluo and Ganhe Shanghehada, two in all;
translations.idiomatic: There are nine karun outposts: Nuominhe Bayanheluo and Ganhe Shanghehada, two in all;

sentences.zh: 又和倫部曰塞楞山，曰喀穆尼峰，凡二；

translations.literal: Also of the Helun tribe: Saileng Mountain and Kamuni Peak, two in all;
translations.idiomatic: Two more belong to the Helun tribe: Saileng Mountain and Kamuni Peak;

sentences.zh: 曰庫雨爾河，曰諾敏河，曰喀布奇勒峰，曰綏楞額山，曰布爾札木，凡五。

translations.literal: Kuyu'er River, Nuomin River, Kabuqile Peak, Suileng'e Mountain, and Bu'erzhumu, five in all.
translations.idiomatic: and five others: Kuyu'er River, Nuomin River, Kabuqile Peak, Suileng'e Mountain, and Bu'erzhumu.

sentences.zh: 府境為水陸通衢，沿江兩岸水土沃饒，屯地之腴，稍遜呼蘭，猶駕諸城而上。

translations.literal: The prefectural territory is a thoroughfare by land and water; the soil and water along both banks of the river are rich; the fertility of garrison settlement lands is slightly inferior to Hulan, yet still surpasses other cities.
translations.idiomatic: The prefecture is a crossroads by land and water. The soil and water along both riverbanks are rich, and although its garrison lands are slightly less fertile than Hulan's, they still rank above those of the other cities.

sentences.zh: 有多布庫爾協領，統鄂倫春人。

translations.literal: There is a Duobuku'er company commander who commands the Oroqen people.
translations.idiomatic: A Duobuku'er company commander is stationed there to command the Oroqen people.

sentences.zh: 訥河直隸廳：省東北二百八十里。

translations.literal: Nehe Directly Administered Subprefecture: 280 li northeast of the province.
translations.idiomatic: Nehe Directly Administered Subprefecture lies 280 li northeast of the provincial seat.

sentences.zh: 即布特哈東路總管。

translations.literal: That is, the Eastern Buteha superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: It is the seat of the Eastern Buteha superintendent.

sentences.zh: 明，布兒哈衛。

translations.literal: Under the Ming, Bu'erha Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming it was Bu'erha Guard.

sentences.zh: 宣統二年，以東布特哈改置。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuantong, it was reorganized from Eastern Buteha.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 2 it was reorganized from Eastern Buteha.

sentences.zh: 廣一千一百餘里，袤七百餘里。

translations.literal: Its width is more than 1,100 li, and its length more than 700 li.
translations.idiomatic: It measures over 1,100 li from east to west and over 700 li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 北極高四十八度五十九分。

translations.literal: Its northern latitude is 48 degrees 59 minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Its latitude is 48°59′ north.

sentences.zh: 京師偏東八度一分。

translations.literal: It lies 8 degrees 1 minute east of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 8°01′ east of the capital.

sentences.zh: 東北：琉璜山、胡爾冬吉。

translations.literal: To the northeast: Liuhuang Mountain and Hu'erdongji.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast lie Liuhuang Mountain and Hu'erdongji.

sentences.zh: 東南：吉爾嘎爾哈瑪圖山。

translations.literal: To the southeast: Jierga'er Hamatu Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast lies Jierga'er Hamatu Mountain.

sentences.zh: 西：嫩江自嫩江府入，南流入龍江。

translations.literal: To the west: the Nen River enters from Nenjiang Prefecture and flows south into Longjiang.
translations.idiomatic: To the west, the Nen River enters from Nenjiang Prefecture and flows south into Longjiang.

sentences.zh: 東南：訥謨爾河。

translations.literal: To the southeast: the Nemuer River.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is the Nemuer River.

sentences.zh: 西北：合黑河烏德鄰池水，自東北來注。

translations.literal: To the northwest: it joins the waters of the Heihe Wudelin Pool, which enter from the northeast.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest, it receives the waters of the Heihe Wudelin Pool, which enter from the northeast.

sentences.zh: 翁查爾河，自東南來注，折西，洪果爾津、芒柰、那彥、額勒合奇諸河，皆自北來注。

translations.literal: The Wengcha'er River joins from the southeast, turns west; the Hongguo'erjin, Mangnai, Nayan, and E'leheqi rivers all join from the north.
translations.idiomatic: The Wengcha'er River enters from the southeast and turns west; the Hongguo'erjin, Mangnai, Nayan, and E'leheqi rivers all join it from the north.

sentences.zh: 保大泉河自東南來注。

translations.literal: The Baodaquan River joins from the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: The Baodaquan River joins from the southeast.

sentences.zh: 又西布拉克河，又羅洛河，皆自北來注，逕廳治南。

translations.literal: Farther west, the Bulake and Luoluo rivers both join from the north and pass south of the subprefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: Farther west, the Bulake and Luoluo rivers both enter from the north and flow past the south of the subprefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 又西，分二支入嫩江。

translations.literal: Farther west, it divides into two branches that enter the Nen River.
translations.idiomatic: Farther west it divides into two branches that flow into the Nen River.

sentences.zh: 東南：胡裕爾河導源胡耳山，西流入廳境。

translations.literal: To the southeast: the Huyu'er River takes its source at Hu'er Mountain and flows west into the subprefectural territory.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast, the Huyu'er River rises at Hu'er Mountain and flows west into the subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 又西，左受印京河，右受敖倫河，入拜泉廳境，本索倫、達呼爾部落人打牲之所。

translations.literal: Farther west, on the left it receives the Yinjing River and on the right the Aolun River, enters Baquan Subprefecture territory, originally a place where Solon and Dahur tribesmen hunted for game.
translations.idiomatic: Farther west it receives the Yinjing River on the left and the Aolun River on the right, enters Baquan Subprefecture, and was originally a hunting ground for Solon and Dahur tribesmen.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十二年，始將南北荒段丈放。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year of Guangxu, the northern and southern wasteland tracts were first surveyed and opened for settlement.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 32, the northern and southern wasteland tracts were first surveyed and opened for reclamation.

sentences.zh: 舊設站二：自龍江寧年站北八十五里至廳屬拉哈，又六十里至博爾多，即廳治。

translations.literal: Two relay stations were formerly established: from the Longjiang Ningnian Station, 85 li north to Laha under the subprefecture, then another 60 li to Bo'erduo, which is the subprefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: Two relay stations were formerly established: from Longjiang Ningnian Station, 85 li north to Laha in the subprefecture, then another 60 li to Bo'erduo, the subprefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 又北接嫩江喀木尼站。

translations.literal: Farther north it connects with the Nen River Kamuni Station.
translations.idiomatic: Farther north it connects with the Kamuni station on the Nen River route.

sentences.zh: 又廳東南頭、二、三站達海倫，即海布新道。

translations.literal: Also from the subprefecture, the first, second, and third stations to the southeast reach Hailun; this is the Haibu New Route.
translations.idiomatic: From the subprefecture, the first three stations southeast also reach Hailun on the Haibu New Route.

sentences.zh: 舊卡倫五：喀爾開圖、烏爾布、齊吉爾吉、哈諾爾、溫托渾喀喇山。

translations.literal: Five former karun outposts: Ka'erkaitu, Wu'erbu, Qijierji, Hanuo'er, and Wentuohun Kalashan.
translations.idiomatic: Five former karun outposts: Ka'erkaitu, Wu'erbu, Qijierji, Hanuo'er, and Wentuohun Kalashan.

sentences.zh: 璦琿直隸廳：省東北八百二十里。

translations.literal: Aigun Directly Administered Subprefecture: 820 li northeast of the province.
translations.idiomatic: Aigun Directly Administered Subprefecture lies 820 li northeast of the provincial seat.

sentences.zh: 即黑龍江副都統城。

translations.literal: That is, the Heilongjiang deputy commander's city.
translations.idiomatic: It is the former seat of the Heilongjiang deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 明，考郎兀衛。

translations.literal: Under the Ming, Kaolangwu Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming it was Kaolangwu Guard.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十四年，以黑龍江城改置。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year of Guangxu, it was reorganized from Heilongjiang City.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 34 it was reorganized from Heilongjiang City.

sentences.zh: 璦琿兵備道駐廳。

translations.literal: The Aigun circuit intendant for military preparedness is stationed at the subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Aigun circuit intendant for military preparedness is stationed there.

sentences.zh: 廣一千三百餘里，袤六百餘里。

translations.literal: Its width is more than 1,300 li, and its length more than 600 li.
translations.idiomatic: It measures over 1,300 li from east to west and over 600 li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 北極高五十度四分。

translations.literal: Its northern latitude is 50 degrees 4 minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Its latitude is 50°04′ north.

sentences.zh: 京師偏東十一度。

translations.literal: It lies 11 degrees east of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 11° east of the capital.

sentences.zh: 西：托列爾哈達、坤安嶺、大橫、樺皮、答儼、青泉山。

translations.literal: To the west: Tuolie'erhada, Kun'an Ridge, Daheng, Huapi, Dayan, and Qingquan Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the west lie Tuolie'erhada, Kun'an Ridge, Daheng, Huapi, Dayan, and Qingquan Mountain.

sentences.zh: 南：札克達齊、博克里。

translations.literal: To the south: Zhakdaqi and Bokeli.
translations.idiomatic: To the south lie Zhakdaqi and Bokeli.

sentences.zh: 東南：吉里爾哈達。

translations.literal: To the southeast: Jilierhada.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast lies Jilierhada.

sentences.zh: 黑龍江自黑河合烏克薩河入，南屈西，右受五道、四道、三道、二道諸溝，屈南，右受頭道溝，逕廳城東。

translations.literal: The Heilongjiang River enters from Heihe after joining the Ukha River, bends south and west, receives on the right the Fifth, Fourth, Third, and Second Channels and other gullies, turns south, receives on the right the First Channel, and passes east of the subprefectural city.
translations.idiomatic: The Heilongjiang River enters from Heihe after joining the Ukha River, bends south and then west, receives the Fifth, Fourth, Third, and Second Channel gullies on the right, turns south again, receives the First Channel on the right, and passes east of the subprefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 又南，右合坤河，折東南，右合康達罕、霍爾穆勒津、博科里，左納伯勒格爾沁河，合博爾和里鄂模水，又東南合遜河，入興東。

translations.literal: Farther south, on the right it joins the Kun River, turns southeast, on the right joins Kandahan, Huo'ermulejin, and Bokeli, on the left receives the Bolege'erqin River, joins the Bo'erheli Emo Stream, and farther southeast joins the Xun River and enters Xingdong.
translations.idiomatic: Farther south it joins the Kun River on the right, turns southeast, and on the right receives the Kandahan, Huo'ermulejin, and Bokeli rivers; on the left it receives the Bolege'erqin River, merges with the Bo'erheli Emo Stream, then joins the Xun River farther southeast and enters Xingdong.

sentences.zh: 江東六十四屯在焉。

translations.literal: The Sixty-Four Settlements east of the river are there.
translations.idiomatic: There lie the Sixty-Four Settlements east of the river.

sentences.zh: 精奇里江以南，黑龍江以北，東以光緒九年封堆為界，有伯勒格爾沁河、博爾和里鄂模，南北一百四十里，東西五十里至七十里，咸豐八年條約，本旗民永住之業。

translations.literal: South of the Jingqiri River and north of the Heilongjiang River, bounded on the east by boundary markers set in the ninth year of Guangxu, with the Bolege'erqin River and Bo'erheli Emo, 140 li from north to south and 50 to 70 li from east to west; under the treaty of the eighth year of Xianfeng, this was land where banner people were permanently to dwell.
translations.idiomatic: The tract south of the Jingqiri River and north of the Heilongjiang, bounded on the east by markers set in Guangxu 9 and containing the Bolege'erqin River and Bo'erheli Emo, measures 140 li north to south and 50 to 70 li east to west. Under the Xianfeng 8 treaty, it was land reserved for the permanent habitation of banner people.

sentences.zh: 庚子之變。

translations.literal: The disturbances of the Gengzi year.
translations.idiomatic: Then came the Boxer uprising of 1900.

sentences.zh: 俄人違約驅奪，且擾及江右，脅耆民為官沈江者至數萬。

translations.literal: Russians violated the treaty, drove the people away and seized the land, and disturbances spread west of the river as well; tens of thousands of elderly commoners were coerced and drowned in the river.
translations.idiomatic: The Russians violated the treaty, drove the people out and seized the land, and disturbances spread west of the river as well; tens of thousands of elderly commoners were coerced and drowned in the river.

sentences.zh: 和約成，光緒三十二年僅收回江右地，六十四屯迄未索還，今廳境僅西南北三鄉耳。

translations.literal: After the peace treaty was concluded, in the thirty-second year of Guangxu only the land west of the river was recovered; the Sixty-Four Settlements have still not been reclaimed, and today the subprefectural territory comprises only three townships in the west, south, and north.
translations.idiomatic: After peace was restored, only the land west of the river was recovered in Guangxu 32; the Sixty-Four Settlements have never been reclaimed, and today the subprefecture comprises only three townships in the west, south, and north.

sentences.zh: 有遜別拉荒段十餘萬晌，光緒末放墾。

translations.literal: There are more than 100,000 shang of Xunbiela wasteland tract, opened for reclamation at the end of Guangxu.
translations.idiomatic: It has more than 100,000 shang of Xunbiela wasteland, opened for reclamation in the late Guangxu period.

sentences.zh: 舊設站三：自嫩江之額勒塔爾奇東北八十五里至廳屬之庫木爾；

translations.literal: Three relay stations were formerly established: from E'letarqi on the Nen River, 85 li northeast to Kumu'er under the subprefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Three relay stations were formerly established: from E'letarqi on the Nen River, 85 li northeast to Kumu'er in the subprefecture;

sentences.zh: 又三十五里至額雨爾；

translations.literal: Then another 35 li to E'yu'er;
translations.idiomatic: then another 35 li to E'yu'er;

sentences.zh: 又百里至黑龍江城，即廳治。

translations.literal: Then another 100 li to Heilongjiang City, which is the subprefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: then another 100 li to Heilongjiang City, the subprefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 此省城北路十站。

translations.literal: These are ten stations on the northern route from the provincial seat.
translations.idiomatic: These are ten stations on the northern route from the provincial seat.

sentences.zh: 又由廳南行至畢拉爾會海畢新道。

translations.literal: Also from the subprefecture south to Bila'er one connects with the Haibi New Route.
translations.idiomatic: From the subprefecture one can also travel south to Bila'er and connect with the Haibi New Route.

sentences.zh: 又北穿森林達漠河，有新設霍爾莫津、奇勒克二卡倫。

translations.literal: Also north through the forest to Mohe, with two newly established karun outposts at Huo'ermojin and Qileke.
translations.idiomatic: Another route runs north through the forest to Mohe, where the newly established Huo'ermojin and Qileke karun outposts lie.

sentences.zh: 商埠，在城北頭道溝、二道溝間，光緒三十一年中日約開。

translations.literal: A commercial port, between the First and Second Channels north of the city, opened under the Sino-Japanese treaty of the thirty-first year of Guangxu.
translations.idiomatic: A treaty port between the First and Second Channel gullies north of the city was opened under the Sino-Japanese agreement of Guangxu 31.

sentences.zh: 按雍正中，舊設卡倫十三。

translations.literal: According to records, in the Yongzheng period thirteen karun outposts were formerly established.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yongzheng, thirteen karun outposts had originally been established.

sentences.zh: 咸豐八年，中、俄分江為界，如伊瑪畢拉昂阿、精奇里河、烏魯穆蘇丹、紐勒們河、黑龍混同兩江會口，五卡倫歸左岸俄境，而右岸境東增八、西增三。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Xianfeng, China and Russia divided the river as the boundary; such places as Yamabilang'a, Jingqiri River, Wulumusudan, Niulemen River, and the confluence of the Heilongjiang and Songhua rivers—five karun outposts fell on the Russian side of the left bank, while on the right bank eight were added to the east and three to the west of the territory.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Xianfeng 8 partition of the river between China and Russia, five karun outposts at Yamabilang'a, the Jingqiri River, Wulumusudan, the Niulemen River, and the confluence of the Heilongjiang and Songhua rivers fell on the Russian left bank, while eight were added to the east and three to the west on the Chinese right bank.

sentences.zh: 光緒十二年，以防護漠河金廠，增西爾根土哈達等二十三，接呼倫貝爾城之珠爾特依。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Guangxu, to protect the Mohe gold mines, twenty-three more were added, including Xi'ergentuhada, connecting with Zhuerteryi at Hulun Buir City.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 12, twenty-three more outposts including Xi'ergentuhada were added to protect the Mohe gold mines, extending to Zhuerteryi at Hulun Buir City.

sentences.zh: 又東南增車勒山、遜河、闊爾斐音河口、吉普遜河、提音河，凡五，共卡倫三十九處。

translations.literal: Also five were added to the southeast: Cheleshan, Xun River, Kuo'erfeiyin River mouth, Jipuxun River, and Tiyin River, thirty-nine karun outposts in all.
translations.idiomatic: Five more were added in the southeast—Cheleshan, the Xun River, the Kuo'erfeiyin River mouth, the Jipuxun River, and the Tiyin River—for thirty-nine karun outposts in all.

sentences.zh: 庚子亂後，卡倫盡毀。

translations.literal: After the Gengzi disturbances, all karun outposts were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: After the Boxer uprising, all the karun outposts were destroyed.

sentences.zh: 遜河以南，劃歸興東道。

translations.literal: South of the Xun River was reassigned to Xingdong Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The territory south of the Xun River was reassigned to Xingdong Circuit.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，乃上自額爾古訥河口起，下迄遜河口止，新設卡倫二十：曰洛古河，曰訥欽哈達，曰漠河，曰烏蘇里，曰巴爾嘎力，曰阿穆爾，曰開庫康，曰安羅，曰依西肯，曰倭西門，曰安干，曰察哈彥，曰望哈達，曰呼瑪爾，曰西爾根奇，曰奇拉，曰札克達霍洛，曰霍爾沁，曰霍爾莫津，曰奇克勒。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year, from the mouth of the Argun River upstream to the mouth of the Xun River downstream, twenty new karun outposts were established: Luoguhe, Neqinhada, Mohe, Wusuli, Ba'ergali, Amur, Kaikukang, Anluo, Yixiken, Wo'ximen, Angan, Chahayan, Wanghada, Humar, Xi'ergenqi, Qila, Zhakdahuoluo, Huo'erqin, Huo'ermojin, and Qikele.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 34, twenty new karun outposts were established from the mouth of the Argun River upstream to the mouth of the Xun River downstream: Luoguhe, Neqinhada, Mohe, Wusuli, Ba'ergali, Amur, Kaikukang, Anluo, Yixiken, Wo'ximen, Angan, Chahayan, Wanghada, Humar, Xi'ergenqi, Qila, Zhakdahuoluo, Huo'erqin, Huo'ermojin, and Qikele.

sentences.zh: 每卡弁一、兵三十。

translations.literal: Each karun has one sergeant and thirty soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Each karun is staffed by one sergeant and thirty soldiers.

sentences.zh: 五卡設卡官一，十卡設一總卡官。

translations.literal: For every five karun one karun officer is appointed; for every ten karun one chief karun officer is appointed.
translations.idiomatic: One karun officer is appointed for every five outposts, and one chief karun officer for every ten.

sentences.zh: 卡兵三十，以十人巡查，以二十人給荒墾種，更番輪替，所得糧即作弁兵津貼。

translations.literal: The thirty karun soldiers: ten patrol, and twenty are assigned to reclaim wasteland and plant crops in rotation; the grain produced serves as stipends for the sergeants and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Of the thirty soldiers at each karun, ten patrol while twenty are assigned in rotation to reclaim wasteland and plant crops; the grain they produce serves as stipends for the sergeants and soldiers.

sentences.zh: 地熟年豐，給地停餉。

translations.literal: When the land becomes fertile and harvests are abundant, land grants cease and stipends stop.
translations.idiomatic: Once the land became productive and harvests were plentiful, land grants were discontinued and stipends withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 黑河府：省東北九百里。

translations.literal: Heihe Prefecture: 900 li northeast of the province.
translations.idiomatic: Heihe Prefecture lies 900 li northeast of the provincial seat.

sentences.zh: 原名大黑河屯。

translations.literal: Formerly called Daheihe Tun.
translations.idiomatic: It was formerly known as Daheihe Tun.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十四年置府，屬璦琿道。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year of Guangxu a prefecture was established; it belongs to Aigun Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: It was established as a prefecture in Guangxu 34 and placed under Aigun Circuit.

sentences.zh: 西：內興安嶺支山之著者，煙筒、白石、庫穆爾室韋山、額勒克爾山。

translations.literal: To the west: notable branch mountains of the Inner Khingan Range—Yantong, Baishi, Kumu'er Shiwei Mountain, and E'leke'er Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the west lie notable spurs of the Inner Khingan Range: Yantong, Baishi, Kumu'er Shiwei Mountain, and E'leke'er Mountain.

sentences.zh: 黑龍江自北來，與俄分界，右受呼瑪爾河，入境。

translations.literal: The Heilongjiang River comes from the north, forms the boundary with Russia, receives the Humar River on the right, and enters the territory.
translations.idiomatic: The Heilongjiang River enters from the north along the Russian border, receives the Humar River on the right, and enters the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 南至西爾伊奇卡倫，合丹河、寬河、奇拉、喀尼、庫倫、克魯倫、達彥、霍力戈必、法別拉、額尼、阿勒喀木諸河。

translations.literal: South to the Xi'eryiqi karun, it joins the Dan, Kuan, Qila, Kani, Kulun, Kelulun, Dayan, Huoligeibi, Fabiela, E'ni, and A'lekamu rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Flowing south to the Xi'eryiqi karun, it receives the Dan, Kuan, Qila, Kani, Kulun, Kelulun, Dayan, Huoligeibi, Fabiela, E'ni, and A'lekamu rivers.

sentences.zh: 又東逕城北，又南，左受精奇里江，右受烏克薩河，入璦琿。

translations.literal: Farther east it passes north of the city, then south; on the left it receives the Jingqiri River and on the right the Ukha River, and enters Aigun.
translations.idiomatic: It then flows east past the north of the city, turns south, receives the Jingqiri River on the left and the Ukha River on the right, and enters Aigun.

sentences.zh: 北呼瑪爾河，導源伊勒呼里山，南北四源，合而東流入境，有倭力克、庫勒郭里、綽諾、札克達齊河自西來注。

translations.literal: To the north, the Humar River takes its source at Yilehuli Mountain; four sources from north and south merge and flow east into the territory; the Wailike, Kuleguoli, Chuonuo, and Zhakdaqi rivers join from the west.
translations.idiomatic: To the north, the Humar River rises at Yilehuli Mountain from four sources north and south, merges, and flows east into the prefecture, receiving the Wailike, Kuleguoli, Chuonuo, and Zhakdaqi rivers from the west.

sentences.zh: 又東呼爾哈，東入黑龍江。

translations.literal: Farther east it is called Hu'erha and flows east into the Heilongjiang River.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east it is known as the Hu'erha and flows east into the Heilongjiang River.

sentences.zh: 源委約七八百里，兩岸為庫瑪爾部貢貂之使馬鄂倫春人等漁獵處。

translations.literal: From source to mouth it is about 700 or 800 li; both banks are fishing and hunting grounds for the Kuma'er tribe of sable-tribute dispatch riders, the Oroqen, and others.
translations.idiomatic: From source to mouth it spans some 700 or 800 li; both banks are fishing and hunting grounds for the Oroqen dispatch riders of the Kuma'er sable-tribute department and others.

sentences.zh: 南岸有呼瑪爾古城。

translations.literal: On the south bank is Humar Old City.
translations.idiomatic: On the south bank stands Humar Old City.

sentences.zh: 府治舊為中、俄通商口岸，初時互市不及江海各口千分之一。

translations.literal: The prefectural seat was formerly a Sino-Russian commercial port; at first its trade did not reach one-thousandth of the various Yangtze and coastal ports.
translations.idiomatic: The prefectural seat was formerly a Sino-Russian trading port, but at first its exchange volume was less than one-thousandth of that at the Yangtze and coastal ports.

sentences.zh: 分江以後，貿易遂繁。

translations.literal: After the river was divided as the boundary, trade became flourishing.
translations.idiomatic: After the river was partitioned as the border, trade grew brisk.

sentences.zh: 自彼銳意經營海蘭泡，又值庚子之變，華商趨附彼境，商務日興，而我驟減。

translations.literal: Since they zealously developed Blagoveshchensk, and moreover the Gengzi disturbances occurred, Chinese merchants flocked to their territory; their commerce daily flourished while ours abruptly declined.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Russians vigorously developed Blagoveshchensk and the Boxer crisis followed, Chinese merchants gravitated to the Russian side; Russian commerce flourished while China's abruptly declined.

sentences.zh: 然府治南屏璦琿，實邊防要衝。

translations.literal: Yet the prefectural seat screens Aigun to the south; it is truly a strategic frontier pass.
translations.idiomatic: Yet as a southern bulwark for Aigun, the prefectural seat is a vital frontier strongpoint.

sentences.zh: 有法別拉荒段十餘萬晌，光緒三十四年放墾。

translations.literal: There are more than 100,000 shang of Fabiela wasteland tract, opened for reclamation in the thirty-fourth year of Guangxu.
translations.idiomatic: It has more than 100,000 shang of Fabiela wasteland, opened for reclamation in Guangxu 34.

sentences.zh: 官商路一：南八十里至璦琿城。

translations.literal: One official merchant road: 80 li south to Aigun City.
translations.idiomatic: One official merchant road runs 80 li south to Aigun.

sentences.zh: 餘皆水路，附俄輪以往。

translations.literal: The rest are all by water, going by attaching to Russian steamers.
translations.idiomatic: All other routes are by water, relying on Russian steamers.

sentences.zh: 有新設卡倫四：曰西爾根奇，曰奇拉札克達，曰霍洛，曰霍爾沁。

translations.literal: Four newly established karun outposts: Xi'ergenqi, Qilazhakda, Huoluo, and Huo'erqin.
translations.idiomatic: Four newly established karun outposts were added: Xi'ergenqi, Qilazhakda, Huoluo, and Huo'erqin.

sentences.zh: 呼倫直隸廳：省西北八百六十里。

translations.literal: Hulun Directly Administered Subprefecture: 860 li northwest of the province.
translations.idiomatic: Hulun Directly Administered Subprefecture lies 860 li northwest of the provincial seat.

sentences.zh: 即呼倫貝爾副都統城。

translations.literal: That is, the Hulun Buir deputy commander's city.
translations.idiomatic: It is the former seat of the Hulun Buir deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 古室韋國。

translations.literal: Ancient Shiwei state.
translations.idiomatic: It was the ancient land of the Shiwei.

sentences.zh: 有室韋山。

translations.literal: There is Shiwei Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Shiwei Mountain lies there.

sentences.zh: 明屬朵顏三衛。

translations.literal: Under the Ming it belonged to the Duoyan Three Guards.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming it belonged to the Duoyan Three Guards.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十四年，以呼倫貝爾城改置。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year of Guangxu, it was reorganized from Hulun Buir City.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 34 it was reorganized from Hulun Buir City.

sentences.zh: 呼倫兵備道駐廳。

translations.literal: The Hulun circuit intendant for military preparedness is stationed at the subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Hulun circuit intendant for military preparedness is stationed there.

sentences.zh: 廣一千一百餘里，袤一千六百里。

translations.literal: Its width is more than 1,100 li, and its length 1,600 li.
translations.idiomatic: It measures over 1,100 li from east to west and 1,600 li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 北極高四十九度三十五分。

translations.literal: Its northern latitude is 49 degrees 35 minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Its latitude is 49°35′ north.

sentences.zh: 京師偏東二度二分。

translations.literal: It lies 2 degrees 2 minutes east of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 2°02′ east of the capital.

sentences.zh: 內興安嶺在東。

translations.literal: The Inner Khingan Range is to the east.
translations.idiomatic: The Inner Khingan Range lies to the east.

sentences.zh: 山脈自索岳爾濟山北走，為伊勒呼里阿林，乃旋而東，餘脈西絡海拉爾河南北岸；

translations.literal: The mountain range runs north from Suoyarji Mountain as the Yilehuli Range, then turns east; residual ranges spread west along both banks of the Hailar River;
translations.idiomatic: The range runs north from Suoyarji Mountain as the Yilehuli Range, then turns east, while its offshoots stretch west along both banks of the Hailar River;

sentences.zh: 額爾古訥河右岸為廳境，諸水源此。

translations.literal: The right bank of the Argun River is subprefectural territory; all waters take their source here.
translations.idiomatic: The subprefecture occupies the right bank of the Argun River, and all local waters rise there.

sentences.zh: 海拉爾河出嶺西麓，西逕綽羅爾，北察爾巴奇山，南納都爾、西札敦，又西特諾克，又西伊敏河，同來注。

translations.literal: The Hailar River issues from the western foot of the range, flows west past Chluor, north of Cha'erbaqi Mountain, receives on the south the Du'er and Xizhadun, farther west the Tenoke, and farther west the Yimin River, all joining together.
translations.idiomatic: The Hailar River rises at the western foot of the range, flows west past Chluor and north of Cha'erbaqi Mountain, and receives the Du'er and Xizhadun from the south, then the Tenoke and Yimin River farther west, all joining together.

sentences.zh: 逕城北，合墨爾根河，入臚濱。

translations.literal: It passes north of the city, joins the Mo'ergen River, and enters Lubin.
translations.idiomatic: It flows past the north of the city, joins the Mo'ergen River, and enters Lubin.

sentences.zh: 西北合額爾古訥入室韋。

translations.literal: To the northwest it joins the Argun River and enters Shiwei.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest it joins the Argun River and flows into Shiwei territory.

sentences.zh: 北：根河西受鄂羅諾爾諸河，又西入額爾古訥河。

translations.literal: To the north: the Gen River on the west receives the Eluonuo'er and other rivers, then west enters the Argun River.
translations.idiomatic: To the north, the Gen River receives the Eluonuo'er and other rivers on the west before flowing into the Argun River.

sentences.zh: 南有達爾彬池，哈爾哈河出，西匯為貝爾池。

translations.literal: To the south is Dalbin Lake; the Khalkha River issues from it and flows west to form Buir Lake.
translations.idiomatic: To the south lies Dalbin Lake; the Khalkha River flows from it westward to form Buir Lake.

sentences.zh: 烏爾順河自池出，北入呼倫池。

translations.literal: The Wulshun River issues from the lake and flows north into Hulun Lake.
translations.idiomatic: The Wulshun River flows north from the lake into Hulun Lake.

sentences.zh: 廳境為索倫、新巴爾虎、厄魯特、陳巴爾虎諸旗牧場。

translations.literal: The subprefectural territory is pastureland for the Solon, New Barhu, Olot, and Old Barhu banners.
translations.idiomatic: The subprefecture is pastureland for the Solon, New Barhu, Olot, and Old Barhu banners.

sentences.zh: 又海拉爾河北有託河路協領，統鄂倫春人。

translations.literal: Also north of the Hailar River there is a Tuohelu company commander who commands the Oroqen people.
translations.idiomatic: North of the Hailar River a Tuohelu company commander is stationed to command the Oroqen people.

sentences.zh: 舊設臺八：自西布特哈之牙爾伯克台西五十里至廳之依爾克特，又五十里呼耳各特伊，又五十里舒都克依，又六十里牙克薩，又五十里哈拉合碩，又六十五里札拉木太，又五十二里哈克鄂模，又六十里呼倫貝爾城，即廳治。

translations.literal: Eight relay stations were formerly established: from Yariboke Station of Western Buteha, 50 li west to Yierkete of the subprefecture, then 50 li to Hu'ergedeyi, then 50 li to Shudukei, then 60 li to Yaksa, then 50 li to Halaheshuo, then 65 li to Zhajiamutai, then 52 li to Hake'emo, then 60 li to Hulun Buir City, which is the subprefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: Eight relay stations were formerly established: from Yariboke in Western Buteha, 50 li west to Yierkete in the subprefecture, then 50 li to Hu'ergedeyi, 50 li to Shudukei, 60 li to Yaksa, 50 li to Halaheshuo, 65 li to Zhajiamutai, 52 li to Hake'emo, and 60 li to Hulun Buir City, the subprefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 為省城西路十七臺。

translations.literal: These are seventeen stations on the western route from the provincial seat.
translations.idiomatic: They form seventeen stations on the western route from the provincial seat.

sentences.zh: 庚子之變，臺站毀，往來皆由東清鐵路。

translations.literal: During the Gengzi disturbances the relay stations were destroyed; all travel now goes by the Chinese Eastern Railway.
translations.idiomatic: After the Boxer uprising destroyed the relay stations, all travel now uses the Chinese Eastern Railway.

sentences.zh: 又西南三百二十裡布野圖布爾都之野壽寧寺，道出張家口。

translations.literal: Also 320 li southwest is Yeshouning Temple at Buyetu Bu'erdu in Buye; the route leads out through Zhangjiakou.
translations.idiomatic: Some 320 li southwest is Yeshouning Temple at Buyetu Bu'erdu in Buye, with a route leading out through Zhangjiakou.

sentences.zh: 寺北八里有大市場，歲八月，內外蒙古走集焉。

translations.literal: Eight li north of the temple is a great market; in the eighth month of each year, Inner and Outer Mongolians gather there.
translations.idiomatic: Eight li north of the temple lies a great market where Inner and Outer Mongolians gather each August.

sentences.zh: 新設卡倫三：曰孟克錫里，曰額爾得尼托羅輝，曰庫克多博，為總卡倫。

translations.literal: Three newly established karun outposts: Mengkexili, E'erdenuoluohui, and Kukeduobo, the last serving as chief karun outpost.
translations.idiomatic: Three new karun outposts were established: Mengkexili, E'erdenuoluohui, and Kukeduobo, which serves as the chief karun outpost.

sentences.zh: 西南有珠爾博特鹽池。

translations.literal: To the southwest is Zhuerbote Salt Lake.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest lies Zhuerbote Salt Lake.

sentences.zh: 東清鐵路自臚濱入境，逕城北，入西布特哈境。

translations.literal: The Chinese Eastern Railway enters from Lubin, passes north of the city, and enters Western Buteha territory.
translations.idiomatic: The Chinese Eastern Railway enters from Lubin, passes north of the city, and continues into Western Buteha.

sentences.zh: 有完工、烏古諾爾、海拉爾、哈克、札爾木、牙克什、免渡河、烏諾爾、伊立克都九車站。

translations.literal: There are nine stations: Wangong, Wugunu'er, Hailar, Hake, Zha'ermu, Yakshi, Mian Duhe, Wu'nuo'er, and Yilikedu.
translations.idiomatic: It has nine stations: Wangong, Wugunu'er, Hailar, Hake, Zha'ermu, Yakshi, Mian Duhe, Wu'nuo'er, and Yilikedu.

sentences.zh: 商埠，光緒三十一年十一月中日約開。

translations.literal: A commercial port, opened under the Sino-Japanese treaty of the eleventh month of the thirty-first year of Guangxu.
translations.idiomatic: A treaty port was opened under the Sino-Japanese agreement of November, Guangxu 31.

sentences.zh: 按呼倫沿邊卡倫，自雍正五年與俄勘界，設察汗敖拉、蘇克特依等卡倫十有二，名外卡倫。

translations.literal: According to records, along the Hulun frontier karun outposts, from the fifth year of Yongzheng when the boundary was surveyed with Russia, twelve karun outposts including Chahan'aola and Suketeiyi were established, called outer karun outposts.
translations.idiomatic: Along the Hulun frontier, twelve outer karun outposts including Chahan'aola and Suketeiyi were established when the border was surveyed with Russia in Yongzheng 5.

sentences.zh: 十一年，復於外卡倫以內設庫里多爾特勒、墨勒津等卡倫十有五，與各外卡倫相距一二百里不等，名曰內卡倫。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, fifteen more karun outposts including Kuliduo'ertele and Mo'lejin were established inside the outer karun outposts, each at varying distances of one or two hundred li from the outer karun outposts, called inner karun outposts.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 11, fifteen inner karun outposts including Kuliduo'ertele and Mo'lejin were established inside the outer outposts, each one or two hundred li from an outer karun.

sentences.zh: 咸豐七年，因內外相距遠，量為遷移，各三四十里，以便互巡。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Xianfeng, because the inner and outer outposts were far apart, they were relocated by measure to thirty or forty li apart to facilitate mutual patrol.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 7, because inner and outer outposts were too far apart, they were relocated to stand thirty or forty li from one another to facilitate mutual patrol.

sentences.zh: 改三卡為三臺，另立新名，後並圮廢無考。

translations.literal: Three karun outposts were changed to three relay stations and given new names; later all fell into ruin and are no longer recorded.
translations.idiomatic: Three karun outposts were converted to relay stations under new names; later they all fell into ruin and are no longer recorded.

sentences.zh: 光緒十年，防俄人越界挖金，由黑龍江城於呼倫珠爾特依卡倫北沿額爾古訥右岸，增莫里勒克等五，前後共外卡倫十有七。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Guangxu, to guard against Russians crossing the border to mine gold, from Heilongjiang City north of the Hulun Zhuerteryi karun outpost along the right bank of the Argun River, five more including Mo'lileke were added, seventeen outer karun outposts in all before and after.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 10, to guard against Russians crossing the border to mine gold, five more outposts including Mo'lileke were added north of the Hulun Zhuerteryi karun along the right bank of the Argun River from Heilongjiang City, for seventeen outer karun outposts in all.

sentences.zh: 庚子並毀。

translations.literal: All were destroyed in the Gengzi year.
translations.idiomatic: All were destroyed during the Boxer uprising.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，重行整頓，首塔爾巴幹達呼山，訖額爾古訥河口，復設二十有一，沿舊名者十有五，新命名者六：曰塔爾巴幹達呼，曰察罕敖拉，曰阿巴該圖，以上屬臚濱；

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year, a thorough reorganization was carried out, from Ta'erbagan Dahu Mountain to the mouth of the Argun River; twenty-one were re-established — fifteen under old names and six newly named: Ta'erbagan Dahu, Chahan'aola, and Aba Gaitu, all subordinate to Lubin;
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 34 the outposts were thoroughly reorganized from Ta'erbagan Dahu Mountain to the mouth of the Argun River. Twenty-one were re-established: fifteen under old names and six newly named — Ta'erbagan Dahu, Chahan'aola, and Aba Gaitu, all subordinate to Lubin.

sentences.zh: 曰孟克西里，曰額爾得尼托羅輝，曰庫克多博，庫克多博為總卡倫，以上屬呼倫；

translations.literal: Mengkexili, E'erdenuoluohui, and Kukeduobo — Kukeduobo serving as chief karun outpost — all subordinate to Hulun;
translations.idiomatic: Mengkexili, E'erdenuoluohui, and Kukeduobo — with Kukeduobo as chief karun outpost — all subordinate to Hulun.

sentences.zh: 曰巴圖爾和碩，曰巴雅斯胡郎圖溫都爾，曰胡裕爾和奇，曰巴彥魯克，曰珠爾特依，曰莫里勒克，曰畢拉爾河，曰牛爾河，曰珠爾干河，珠爾干河為總卡倫；

translations.literal: Batu'erheshuo, Bayasihulangtu Wendu'er, Huyu'erheqi, Bayanluke, Zhuerteryi, Mo'lileke, Bilar River, Niu'er River, and Zhuer'gan River — Zhuer'gan River serving as chief karun outpost;
translations.idiomatic: Batu'erheshuo, Bayasihulangtu Wendu'er, Huyu'erheqi, Bayanluke, Zhuerteryi, Mo'lileke, Bilar River, Niu'er River, and Zhuer'gan River — with Zhuer'gan River as chief karun outpost.

sentences.zh: 曰溫河，曰長甸，曰伊穆河，曰奇乾河，曰永安山，曰額勒哈達，以上屬室韋。

translations.literal: Wen River, Changdian, Yimu River, Qiqian River, Yong'an Mountain, and E'lehada — all subordinate to Shiwei.
translations.idiomatic: Wen River, Changdian, Yimu River, Qiqian River, Yong'an Mountain, and E'lehada — all subordinate to Shiwei.

sentences.zh: 先是俄人越界墾地刈草，至是驅逐，呼倫設邊墾總局，臚濱設分局，俄人遵章納稅，華人領票經商者，絡驛不絕。

translations.literal: Previously Russians had crossed the border to reclaim land and cut hay; at this time they were expelled. Hulun established a frontier reclamation general bureau, and Lubin a branch bureau. Russians paid taxes according to regulations, and Chinese traders with permits passed through in an unbroken stream.
translations.idiomatic: Russians had previously crossed the border to farm and cut hay; they were now driven out. Hulun established a frontier reclamation general bureau and Lubin a branch bureau. Russians paid taxes under the regulations, and Chinese merchants with travel permits streamed through without pause.

sentences.zh: 此光緒三十四年冬月事也。

translations.literal: This was an affair of the winter month of the thirty-fourth year of Guangxu.
translations.idiomatic: This took place in the winter of Guangxu 34.

sentences.zh: 又呼倫西南舊十六卡倫，凡以防喀爾喀也。

translations.literal: In addition, southwest of Hulun there were sixteen old karun outposts, all to guard against the Khalkha.
translations.idiomatic: Southwest of Hulun there were also sixteen older karun outposts, all intended to guard against the Khalkha.

sentences.zh: 臚濱府：省西北一千一百六十里。

translations.literal: Lubin Prefecture: 1,160 li northwest of the province.
translations.idiomatic: Lubin Prefecture lies 1,160 li northwest of the provincial seat.

sentences.zh: 原名滿洲里，為東清鐵路入中國第一車站。

translations.literal: Formerly called Manzhouli, it was the first station of the Chinese Eastern Railway entering China.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly called Manzhouli, it was the first station of the Chinese Eastern Railway upon entering China.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十四年，初擬設滿珠府，後更名，屬呼倫道。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year of Guangxu, Manzhu Prefecture was initially proposed, then renamed; it was subordinate to Hulun Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 34 a Manzhu Prefecture was first proposed, then renamed; it was subordinate to Hulun Circuit.

sentences.zh: 東：額爾古訥河自呼倫入，西北流，至近阿巴該圖山，分二派。

translations.literal: To the east: the Argun River enters from Hulun, flows northwest, and near Aba Gaitu Mountain divides into two branches.
translations.idiomatic: To the east the Argun River enters from Hulun and flows northwest; near Aba Gaitu Mountain it divides into two branches.

sentences.zh: 一西南流，為達蘭鄂洛木河，入呼倫池。

translations.literal: One flows southwest as the Dalain Elom River and enters Hulun Lake.
translations.idiomatic: One branch flows southwest as the Dalain Elom River and enters Hulun Lake.

sentences.zh: 其正流由山西東北流，為額爾古訥河。

translations.literal: The main current flows northeast along the west of the mountains as the Argun River.
translations.idiomatic: The main stream flows northeast along the western foothills as the Argun River.

sentences.zh: 流至此作大轉折，如人曲腰以手遞物。

translations.literal: Flowing here it makes a great bend, like a person bending at the waist to hand something over.
translations.idiomatic: Here it makes a great bend, like someone bending at the waist to pass an object from hand to hand.

sentences.zh: 額爾古訥，蒙古語謂以手遞物也。

translations.literal: Argun, in Mongolian, means to hand something over.
translations.idiomatic: Argun is Mongolian for handing something over.

sentences.zh: 海拉爾河轉為額爾古訥河，分二汊，一沿東岸流，曰海拉爾河口，一沿西岸流，曰額爾古訥河，北行復合為一，入黑龍江。

translations.literal: The Hailar River becomes the Argun River and splits into two channels: one along the east bank called the Hailar River mouth, one along the west bank called the Argun River; they run north, reunite as one, and enter the Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: The Hailar River becomes the Argun River and splits into two channels — one along the east bank called the Hailar River mouth, one along the west bank still called the Argun River. They run north, reunite, and enter the Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 自阿巴該圖山以下為中、俄界水，康熙二十八年，尼布楚約立界碑。

translations.literal: From below Aba Gaitu Mountain it is a Sino-Russian boundary river; in the twenty-eighth year of Kangxi boundary markers were erected under the Nerchinsk Treaty.
translations.idiomatic: From below Aba Gaitu Mountain it forms the Sino-Russian boundary river; boundary markers were erected there under the Nerchinsk Treaty in Kangxi 28.

sentences.zh: 克魯倫河自喀爾喀部入，達蘭鄂洛木河自海拉爾河分出，均入呼倫池，瀦而不流，故呼倫為鹹水湖。

translations.literal: The Kerulen River enters from the Khalkha lands, and the Dalain Elom River branches from the Hailar River; both enter Hulun Lake, which stagnates without outflow, so Hulun is a saltwater lake.
translations.idiomatic: The Kerulen River enters from Khalkha territory and the Dalain Elom River branches from the Hailar River; both flow into Hulun Lake, which has no outlet and therefore remains a salt lake.

sentences.zh: 東南有烏爾順河，自貝爾池出，北流入呼倫池。

translations.literal: To the southeast the Wulshun River issues from Buir Lake and flows north into Hulun Lake.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast the Wulshun River issues from Buir Lake and flows north into Hulun Lake.

sentences.zh: 其右岸為呼倫廳境，有新巴爾虎各旗牧場。

translations.literal: Its right bank is Hulun Subprefecture territory, with pasturelands of the New Barhu banners.
translations.idiomatic: Its right bank lies within Hulun Subprefecture, where the New Barhu banners pasture their herds.

sentences.zh: 舊設中、俄國界鄂博六：曰塔爾郭達固，曰察罕烏魯，曰博羅托羅海，曰索克圖，曰額爾底里托羅海，曰阿巴哈依圖，此為庫倫東中、俄界第六十三鄂博。

translations.literal: Six old Sino-Russian boundary oboo were established: Ta'erguoda, Chahan'uru, Bolotuoluo Hai, Suoketu, E'erdiluotuoluo Hai, and Abahayitu — this was the sixty-third Sino-Russian boundary oboo east of Urga.
translations.idiomatic: Six old Sino-Russian boundary oboo were established: Ta'erguoda, Chahan'uru, Bolotuoluo Hai, Suoketu, E'erdiluotuoluo Hai, and Abahayitu — the sixty-third Sino-Russian boundary oboo east of Urga.

sentences.zh: 雍正五年恰克圖約鄂博止此。

translations.literal: The Kyakhta Treaty oboo stopped here in the fifth year of Yongzheng.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Kyakhta Treaty the boundary oboo ended here in Yongzheng 5.

sentences.zh: 塔爾巴幹達呼山西南即喀爾喀界，有滿、蒙文界碑，系呼倫與喀爾喀分界，十年一換。

translations.literal: Southwest of Ta'erbagan Dahu Mountain is the Khalkha border; there are Manchu-Mongolian boundary steles marking the border between Hulun and the Khalkha, replaced every ten years.
translations.idiomatic: Southwest of Ta'erbagan Dahu Mountain lies the Khalkha border, marked by Manchu-Mongolian boundary steles between Hulun and the Khalkha that are replaced every ten years.

sentences.zh: 有新設卡倫三：曰塔爾巴幹達呼，曰察罕敖拉，曰阿巴該圖。

translations.literal: Three newly established karun outposts: Ta'erbagan Dahu, Chahan'aola, and Aba Gaitu.
translations.idiomatic: Three new karun outposts were established: Ta'erbagan Dahu, Chahan'aola, and Aba Gaitu.

sentences.zh: 北有金源邊堡。

translations.literal: To the north is the Jinyuan border fort.
translations.idiomatic: To the north stands the Jinyuan border fort.

sentences.zh: 東清鐵路自俄薩拜喀勒省入中國境，逕府治東，入呼倫廳。

translations.literal: The Chinese Eastern Railway enters China's territory from Russian Sabkhal Province, passes east of the prefectural seat, and enters Hulun Subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Chinese Eastern Railway enters China from Russian Sabkhal Province, passes east of the prefectural seat, and continues into Hulun Subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 有滿洲里，咱剛，扎賚諾爾，赫勒洪德四車站。

translations.literal: There are four stations: Manzhouli, Zangang, Zhalainuo'er, and Helehongde.
translations.idiomatic: It has four stations: Manzhouli, Zangang, Zhalainuo'er, and Helehongde.

sentences.zh: 商埠，中日約開。

translations.literal: A commercial port, opened under a Sino-Japanese treaty.
translations.idiomatic: A treaty port opened under a Sino-Japanese agreement.

sentences.zh: 有海關。

translations.literal: There is a customs house.
translations.idiomatic: There is a customs house.

sentences.zh: 興東道：省東北一千五百里。

translations.literal: Xingdong Circuit: 1,500 li northeast of the province.
translations.idiomatic: Xingdong Circuit lies 1,500 li northeast of the provincial seat.

sentences.zh: 明為黑龍江地面，及速溫河衛、真河所等地。

translations.literal: Under the Ming this was Heilongjiang territory, including Suwen River Guard, Zhenhe Station, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming this was Heilongjiang territory, including Suwen River Guard, Zhenhe Station, and other posts.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十二年，移綏化城之綏蘭海道駐內興安嶺迤東，更名興東兵備道，專辦墾務、林、礦各事宜。
