translations.literal: In the thirty-second year of Guangxu, the Suilanhai Circuit stationed at Suihua City was moved east of the Inner Khingan Range, renamed the Xingdong circuit intendant for military preparedness, and charged solely with reclamation, forestry, and mining affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 32 the Suilanhai Circuit, then stationed at Suihua City, was moved east of the Inner Khingan Range, renamed the Xingdong circuit intendant for military preparedness, and charged solely with reclamation, forestry, and mining.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，建署托蘿山北，為道治。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year an office was built north of Tuoluo Mountain as the circuit seat.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 34 an office was built north of Tuoluo Mountain to serve as the circuit seat.

sentences.zh: 領縣二。

translations.literal: It administers two counties.
translations.idiomatic: It administers two counties.

sentences.zh: 內興安嶺脈自璦琿入，南行為嫩江與黑龍江之分水嶺，至海倫東北迤東為黑龍江與松花江之分水嶺，曰布倫山，曰佛斯亨山，盡於黑龍、松花兩江匯處，謂之小興安嶺。

translations.literal: The Inner Khingan Range enters from Aihun, running south as the watershed between the Nen and Heilong rivers; east of Helen it turns east as the watershed between the Heilongjiang and Songhua rivers — Buren Mountain and Fosheng Mountain — ending at the confluence of the Heilong and Songhua rivers, called the Lesser Khingan Range.
translations.idiomatic: The Inner Khingan Range enters from Aihun and runs south as the divide between the Nen and Heilong rivers; east of Helen it turns eastward as the divide between the Heilongjiang and Songhua rivers — Buren Mountain and Fosheng Mountain — ending at their confluence, known as the Lesser Khingan Range.

sentences.zh: 黑龍江自璦琿合遜河入境，東南流，科爾芬河上源曰額爾皮河，又東南，右受噶其河，西都里、古勒庫拉、畢罕嘎、其達、莫里、烏雲諸河，自西南來注。

translations.literal: The Heilongjiang enters at Aihun where it joins the Xun River and flows southeast; the upper course of the Korfen River is called the E'erpi River; farther southeast it receives on the right the Gaqi River, and the Xiduli, Gulekula, Bihanga, Qida, Mo'li, and Wuyun rivers from the southwest.
translations.idiomatic: The Heilongjiang enters at Aihun where it joins the Xun River and flows southeast. The upper Korfen River is called the E'erpi River; farther southeast it receives the Gaqi River on the right, and the Xiduli, Gulekula, Bihanga, Qida, Mo'li, and Wuyun rivers from the southwest.

sentences.zh: 又東南，右受佳勒河、輔河，屈南，嘉廕河自西來注。

translations.literal: Farther southeast it receives on the right the Jiale and Fu rivers, turns south, and the Jiayin River joins from the west.
translations.idiomatic: Farther southeast it receives the Jiale and Fu rivers on the right, turns south, and the Jiayin River joins from the west.

sentences.zh: 又南逕道治東而南，有秋台河自西曲折來注。

translations.literal: It turns south past the east of the circuit seat, and the Qiutai River joins from the west in winding course.
translations.idiomatic: It turns south past the east of the circuit seat, where the Qiutai River joins from the west in a winding course.

sentences.zh: 屈東，右受斐爾法鄂模水、布占河、伊里河，會松花江。

translations.literal: It turns east, receives on the right the Feierfa'emo Stream, Bozhan River, and Yili River, and joins the Songhua River.
translations.idiomatic: It turns east, receives the Feierfa'emo Stream, Bozhan River, and Yili River on the right, and joins the Songhua River.

sentences.zh: 北有遜河，東流有占河，右合阿爾沁，匯入黑龍江。

translations.literal: To the north the Xun River flows east; there is the Zhan River, which on the right joins the Arqin and flows into the Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: To the north the Xun River flows east; the Zhan River, receiving the Arqin on the right, flows into the Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 其左岸為璦琿境。

translations.literal: Its left bank is Aihun territory.
translations.idiomatic: Its left bank lies within Aihun territory.

sentences.zh: 西：都魯，又西湯旺，右合伊春札里河，又西巴蘭河，東流屈南，皆入湯原。

translations.literal: To the west: Dulu, farther west Tangwang, which on the right joins the Yichun Zhahe River; farther west the Balan River, which flows east and turns south — all enter Tangyuan.
translations.idiomatic: To the west lie the Dulu and, farther west, the Tangwang rivers; the latter receives the Yichun Zhahe River on the right. Farther west the Balan River flows east and turns south — all enter Tangyuan.

sentences.zh: 道治瀕黑龍江右岸，與俄屯松由子隔江對峙。

translations.literal: The circuit seat stands on the right bank of the Heilongjiang, facing across the river the Russian settlement of Tun Song Youzi.
translations.idiomatic: The circuit seat stands on the right bank of the Heilongjiang, facing the Russian settlement of Tun Song Youzi across the river.

sentences.zh: 西北：占河、遜河匯流，上段有畢拉爾、鄂倫春協領。

translations.literal: To the northwest the Zhan and Xun rivers meet; on the upper reaches there is a Bilal Oroqen company commander.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest the Zhan and Xun rivers meet; on the upper reaches a Bilal Oroqen company commander is stationed.

sentences.zh: 鄂倫春本打牲部落，不識文字稼穡，為俄人誆誘。

translations.literal: The Oroqen were originally a hunting tribe that knew neither writing nor grain cultivation, and were deceived and lured by the Russians.
translations.idiomatic: The Oroqen were originally a hunting people who knew neither writing nor farming, and were deceived and enticed by the Russians.

sentences.zh: 光緒末年，始議收撫。

translations.literal: At the end of the Guangxu reign, plans were first made to bring them under control.
translations.idiomatic: Only at the end of the Guangxu reign were plans first made to bring them under control.

sentences.zh: 興東道兼署協領，創設墾務局、學堂。

translations.literal: The Xingdong circuit intendant also served as company commander, establishing reclamation bureaus and schools.
translations.idiomatic: The Xingdong circuit intendant also held the post of company commander and established reclamation bureaus and schools.

sentences.zh: 興安嶺嶺西有龍門鎮，黑龍江南岸有兆興鎮、裕興鎮，墾務皆盛。

translations.literal: West of the Khingan Range there is Longmen Town; on the south bank of the Heilongjiang there are Zhaoxing and Yuxing towns — reclamation flourished in all.
translations.idiomatic: West of the Khingan Range lies Longmen Town; on the south bank of the Heilongjiang are Zhaoxing and Yuxing towns — reclamation flourished in all of them.

sentences.zh: 官商路三：舊有由齊齊哈爾至觀音山路，

translations.literal: Three official and commercial routes: the old route from Qiqihar to Guanyin Mountain;
translations.idiomatic: There are three official and commercial routes: the old route from Qiqihar to Guanyin Mountain;

sentences.zh: 光緒三十四年，新開自興東逕煙筒山赴湯原，為西南路；

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year of Guangxu, a newly opened route from Xingdong via Yantong Mountain to Tangyuan, as the southwest route;
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year of Guangxu, a newly opened route from Xingdong via Yantong Mountain to Tangyuan, forming the southwest route;

sentences.zh: 又由觀音山經湯原境至三姓，為西路。

translations.literal: and another from Guanyin Mountain through Tangyuan to Sanxing, as the west route.
translations.idiomatic: and another from Guanyin Mountain through Tangyuan to Sanxing, forming the west route.

sentences.zh: 宣統二年，新開海畢道，可由畢拉爾達海倫。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuantong a new Haibi route was opened, running from Bilal to Hailun.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 2 a new Haibi route was opened from Bilal to Hailun.

sentences.zh: 大通縣道治西南五百二十里。

translations.literal: Datong County: 520 li southwest of the circuit seat.
translations.idiomatic: Datong County lies 520 li southwest of the circuit seat.

sentences.zh: 原為崇古爾庫站，吉林江北五站之一。

translations.literal: Formerly Chonggu'erku Station, one of the five Jilin north-of-river stations.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Chonggu'erku Station, one of the five Jilin stations north of the river.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十一年置，為吉林依蘭屬縣。

translations.literal: Established in the thirty-first year of Guangxu as a county subordinate to Yilan in Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: Established in Guangxu 31 as a county subordinate to Yilan in Jilin.

sentences.zh: 三十四年改隸。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year its jurisdiction was changed.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 34 its jurisdiction was changed.

sentences.zh: 北有內興安嶺山脈縈帶，南皆平野。

translations.literal: To the north the Inner Khingan Range forms a belt; to the south all is flat plain.
translations.idiomatic: The Inner Khingan Range girdles the north; to the south lies open plain.

sentences.zh: 南：松花江自木蘭入，東流迤東北入湯原，其右岸為吉林方正。

translations.literal: To the south the Songhua River enters from Mulan, flows east and northeast into Tangyuan; its right bank is Fangzheng in Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: To the south the Songhua River enters from Mulan, flows east and northeast into Tangyuan; its right bank is Fangzheng in Jilin.

sentences.zh: 西：岔林、小橋子、富拉渾、頭道、二道、三道、四道沙河、轉心湖、二道河子，皆南入松花江。

translations.literal: To the west: Chalin, Xiaoqiaozi, Fulahun, first, second, third, and fourth channel sand rivers, Zhuanxin Lake, and Erdaohezi — all flow south into the Songhua River.
translations.idiomatic: To the west the Chalin, Xiaoqiaozi, Fulahun, first through fourth channel sand rivers, Zhuanxin Lake, and Erdaohezi all flow south into the Songhua River.

sentences.zh: 二道河子右岸為木蘭境，東有大通河，縣以此名。

translations.literal: On the right bank of Erdaohezi is Mulan territory; to the east is the Datong River, from which the county takes its name.
translations.idiomatic: Erdaohezi's right bank lies in Mulan territory; to the east is the Datong River, from which the county takes its name.

sentences.zh: 又東烏拉琿、大古洞、小古洞河，亦南入松花江。

translations.literal: Farther east the Wulahui, Dagudong, and Xiaogudong rivers also flow south into the Songhua River.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east the Wulahui, Dagudong, and Xiaogudong rivers also flow south into the Songhua River.

sentences.zh: 小古洞河左岸為湯原境。

translations.literal: On the left bank of the Xiaogudong River is Tangyuan territory.
translations.idiomatic: The left bank of the Xiaogudong River lies within Tangyuan territory.

sentences.zh: 烏拉琿河西流，匯為二泊，曰三捷泡，曰二龍潭，泊旁地肥饒。

translations.literal: The Wulahui River flows west and gathers into two lakes, Sanjie Pao and Erlong Tan; the land beside the lakes is rich and fertile.
translations.idiomatic: The Wulahui River flows west and gathers into two lakes, Sanjie Pao and Erlong Tan, with rich land beside them.

sentences.zh: 站路一。

translations.literal: One relay route.
translations.idiomatic: There is one relay route.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十七年，吉林借江北地設五站，由今賓州渡江東行入縣，曰佛斯𢗝，曰富拉渾，曰崇古爾庫，即縣治，曰鄂爾國木索，又東接今湯原之妙噶山站，以達三姓城。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year of Qianlong, Jilin borrowed north-of-river land to establish five stations: from present Binzhou crossing the river east into the county — Fosheng, Fulahun, Chonggu'erku, which is the county seat, E'erguomusuo — then east connecting to present Tangyuan's Miaogeshan Station to reach Sanxing City.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 27 Jilin borrowed land north of the river to establish five stations: from present Binzhou one crossed east into the county at Fosheng, Fulahun, Chonggu'erku — the county seat — and E'erguomusuo, then east to present Tangyuan's Miaogeshan Station and on to Sanxing City.

sentences.zh: 光緒末，各站改隸，皆設文報局。

translations.literal: At the end of Guangxu each station's jurisdiction was changed and document relay bureaus were established.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Guangxu reign each station's jurisdiction was changed and document relay bureaus were established.

sentences.zh: 湯原縣道治西南三百五十里，明，屯河衛。

translations.literal: Tangyuan County: 350 li southwest of the circuit seat; under the Ming, Tunhe Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Tangyuan County lies 350 li southwest of the circuit seat; under the Ming it was Tunhe Guard.

sentences.zh: 屯河即湯旺河，光緒三十一年置，為吉林依蘭屬縣，三十四年改隸。

translations.literal: Tunhe is the Tangwang River; established in the thirty-first year of Guangxu as a county subordinate to Yilan in Jilin; in the thirty-fourth year its jurisdiction was changed.
translations.idiomatic: Tunhe is the Tangwang River. Established in Guangxu 31 as a county subordinate to Yilan in Jilin, it was reassigned in Guangxu 34.

sentences.zh: 北當小興安嶺山脈南麓，南近松花江，地坦平。

translations.literal: To the north it faces the southern foothills of the Lesser Khingan Range; to the south it nears the Songhua River; the land is level and flat.
translations.idiomatic: To the north it faces the southern foothills of the Lesser Khingan Range; to the south it nears the Songhua River; the terrain is level and open.

sentences.zh: 松花江自大通入，東北流，逕縣治東，會黑龍江。

translations.literal: The Songhua River enters from Datong, flows northeast, passes east of the county seat, and joins the Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: The Songhua River enters from Datong, flows northeast past the east of the county seat, and joins the Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 松花江在縣境流甚曲，岸樹深雜，航路如蚓行。

translations.literal: Within the county the Songhua River's course is very winding; deep trees crowd the banks, and the navigation channel winds like an earthworm.
translations.idiomatic: Within the county the Songhua winds sharply; dense woods crowd the banks, and the channel twists like an earthworm.

sentences.zh: 其右岸為吉林依蘭、富錦、臨江。

translations.literal: Its right bank is Yilan, Fujin, and Linjiang in Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: Its right bank lies within Yilan, Fujin, and Linjiang in Jilin.

sentences.zh: 南：湯旺河自興東入，南流，受如意河，窪丹、蘇拉巴蘭、小古洞河，皆東南流入松花江。

translations.literal: To the south the Tangwang River enters from Xingdong, flows south, receives Ruyi River, and Wadan, Sulabalan, and Xiaogudong rivers — all flow southeast into the Songhua River.
translations.idiomatic: To the south the Tangwang River enters from Xingdong and flows south, receiving the Ruyi, Wadan, Sulabalan, and Xiaogudong rivers — all flowing southeast into the Songhua.

sentences.zh: 小古洞河右岸為大通境。

translations.literal: On the right bank of the Xiaogudong River is Datong territory.
translations.idiomatic: The right bank of the Xiaogudong River lies within Datong territory.

sentences.zh: 東北香蘭，西半節、赫金、各節、花爾布、阿凌達、鶴立諸河，左合梧桐、蒲鴨、額勒密十二入代河，皆東南入松花江。

translations.literal: To the northeast Xianglan; the western Banjie, Hejin, Gejie, Hua'erbu, Alingda, and Heli rivers, which on the left join the Wutong, Puya, and E'lemi rivers and twelve others into the Dai River — all flow southeast into the Songhua River.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast lies Xianglan; the Banjie, Hejin, Gejie, Hua'erbu, Alingda, and Heli rivers to the west, joining on the left with the Wutong, Puya, E'lemi, and twelve other streams into the Dai River, all flow southeast into the Songhua.

sentences.zh: 黑龍江有沱流決出，入松花江，西小黑河入之。

translations.literal: A branch of the Heilongjiang breaks out and enters the Songhua River; the Xiaohei River enters it from the west.
translations.idiomatic: A branch of the Heilongjiang breaks away and enters the Songhua; the Xiaohei River joins it from the west.

sentences.zh: 港汊縈迴，形同溝洫，為奧區上腴。

translations.literal: Channels and creeks wind back on themselves like irrigation ditches, forming rich marshland.
translations.idiomatic: Channels and creeks loop back on themselves like irrigation ditches, forming exceptionally rich marshland.

sentences.zh: 有高家屯巡司。

translations.literal: There is a Gaojiatun patrol sub-office.
translations.idiomatic: There is a Gaojiatun patrol sub-office.

sentences.zh: 宣統二年，置額勒密河招徠鎮，有東益公司，鶴立河有興東公司，皆營墾務。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuantong the E'lemi River Settlement Town was established; there is the Dongyi Company, and at Heli River the Xingdong Company — all operating reclamation.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 2 the E'lemi River Settlement Town was established; the Dongyi Company was founded there, and the Xingdong Company at Heli River — all engaged in reclamation.

sentences.zh: 縣境自西南至東北，狹長千餘里，若盡開闢，可設十縣。

translations.literal: The county territory from southwest to northeast is narrow and long, more than 1,000 li; if fully opened it could support ten counties.
translations.idiomatic: The county runs narrow and long from southwest to northeast for more than 1,000 li; fully opened, it could support ten counties.

sentences.zh: 西南稍繁庶，東北權輿而已。

translations.literal: The southwest is somewhat prosperous; the northeast has only begun.
translations.idiomatic: The southwest is somewhat settled; the northeast has only begun to be developed.

sentences.zh: 站路自妙噶山站渡江至三姓，又有自興東煙筒山達縣西南，自觀音山歷縣境至三姓之西路。

translations.literal: Relay routes run from Miaogeshan Station crossing the river to Sanxing; also from Xingdong Yantong Mountain reaching the county southwest, and from Guanyin Mountain through the county to Sanxing on the west route.
translations.idiomatic: Relay routes run from Miaogeshan Station across the river to Sanxing; others run from Xingdong Yantong Mountain to the county southwest, and from Guanyin Mountain through the county to Sanxing on the west route.

sentences.zh: 光緒末，新開有各節河、窪丹河文報局。

translations.literal: At the end of Guangxu new document relay bureaus were opened at Gejie River and Wadan River.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Guangxu reign new document relay bureaus were opened at Gejie River and Wadan River.

sentences.zh: 肇州直隸廳：繁，難。

translations.literal: Zhaozhou Directly Administered Subprefecture: populous, difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaozhou Directly Administered Subprefecture: populous and difficult to administer.

sentences.zh: 省東南六百里。

translations.literal: 600 li southeast of the province.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 600 li southeast of the provincial seat.

sentences.zh: 明，撒察河衛，即三岔河衛。

translations.literal: Under the Ming, Sachahe Guard, that is Sanchahe Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming it was Sachahe Guard, also called Sanchahe Guard.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十二年，以郭爾羅斯後旗墾地置廳。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year of Guangxu a subprefecture was established on reclaimed land of the Rear Gorlos Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 32 a subprefecture was established on reclaimed land of the Rear Gorlos Banner.

sentences.zh: 南：松花江自吉林伯都訥入境，匯嫩江，東流，受博爾古哈泊水，逕城南，又東受蓮花泊水、下代吉船口水、三道岡子水、澇洲船口水，入呼蘭。

translations.literal: To the south the Songhua River enters from Boduna in Jilin, joins the Nen River, flows east, receives Boregoha Lake water, passes south of the city, then east receives Lianhua Lake water, lower Daiji boat mouth water, third gangzi water, and Laozhou boat mouth water, and enters Hulan.
translations.idiomatic: To the south the Songhua River enters from Boduna in Jilin, joins the Nen River, and flows east, receiving Boregoha Lake water; it passes south of the city, then east receives Lianhua Lake water, lower Daiji boat mouth water, third gangzi water, and Laozhou boat mouth water before entering Hulan.

sentences.zh: 右岸為吉林新城、雙城境。

translations.literal: The right bank is Xincheng and Shuangcheng in Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: Its right bank lies within Xincheng and Shuangcheng in Jilin.

sentences.zh: 西：嫩江自安達入，南流，受烏蘭諾爾水，注松花江。

translations.literal: To the west the Nen River enters from Anda, flows south, receives Wulanuo'er water, and joins the Songhua River.
translations.idiomatic: To the west the Nen River enters from Anda, flows south, receives Wulanuo'er water, and joins the Songhua River.

sentences.zh: 右岸為大賚境。

translations.literal: The right bank is Da'an territory.
translations.idiomatic: Its right bank lies within Da'an territory.

sentences.zh: 廳境平曠，北城泡南出匯為差達瑪泊，下流瀦於沙。

translations.literal: The subprefectural territory is flat and open; lake water south of the north city wall gathers into Chadama Lake, which stagnates in sand downstream.
translations.idiomatic: The subprefecture is flat and open; waters south of the north city wall gather into Chadama Lake, which stagnates in sand downstream.

sentences.zh: 東北有肇東分防經歷。

translations.literal: To the northeast there is a Zhaodong assistant sub-prefect for frontier defense.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast there is a Zhaodong assistant sub-prefect for frontier defense.

sentences.zh: 舊設站三：自安達之他拉哈站南至廳之古魯，又南至烏蘭諾爾，又南至茂興，此南路十站。

translations.literal: Three old stations were established: from Talaha Station in Anda south to Gulu in the subprefecture, then south to Wulanuo'er, then south to Maoxing — ten stations on this southern route.
translations.idiomatic: Three old stations were established on the southern route of ten: from Talaha in Anda south to Gulu in the subprefecture, then south to Wulanuo'er, then south to Maoxing.

sentences.zh: 又東南路八臺，在廳境者四。

translations.literal: Another eight stations on the southeast route, four within the subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The southeast route has eight stations, four of them within the subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 自茂興站起，東至波爾吉哈台，又東至察布奇爾，又東至鄂你多圖，又東至布拉克，又東入呼蘭境。

translations.literal: Starting from Maoxing Station east to Bo'erjiha Tai, then east to Chabuchi'er, then east to Eniduotu, then east to Bulake, then east entering Hulan territory.
translations.idiomatic: From Maoxing Station east to Bo'erjiha Tai, then east to Chabuchi'er, Eniduotu, and Bulake, then east into Hulan territory.

sentences.zh: 官商路一：自茂興西至郭爾羅斯公府，又西由八家船口渡嫩江入大賚。

translations.literal: One official and commercial route: from Maoxing west to the Gorlos princely headquarters, then west crossing the Nen River at Bajia boat mouth into Da'an.
translations.idiomatic: There is one official and commercial route: from Maoxing west to the Gorlos princely headquarters, then west across the Nen at Bajia boat mouth into Da'an.

sentences.zh: 東北五站。

translations.literal: Five northeast stations.
translations.idiomatic: There are five northeast stations.

sentences.zh: 商埠，西南信宿岡子，伯都訥、哈爾濱適中地，沿江要衝，光緒末勘留商埠。

translations.literal: Commercial port: Xinsu Gangzi in the southwest, midway between Boduna and Harbin, a strategic point along the river; surveyed and reserved as a commercial port at the end of Guangxu.
translations.idiomatic: Treaty port: Xinsu Gangzi in the southwest, midway between Boduna and Harbin on a vital stretch of river; surveyed and reserved as a treaty port at the end of the Guangxu reign.

sentences.zh: 東清鐵路自安達入境，逕廳東北入呼蘭。

translations.literal: The Chinese Eastern Railway enters from Anda, passes northeast of the subprefecture, and enters Hulan.
translations.idiomatic: The Chinese Eastern Railway enters from Anda, passes northeast of the subprefecture, and continues into Hulan.

sentences.zh: 有酣草岡、滿溝二車站。

translations.literal: There are two railway stations: Hancao'gang and Mangou.
translations.idiomatic: It has two railway stations: Hancao'gang and Mangou.

sentences.zh: 大賚直隸廳：衝，疲，難。

translations.literal: Da'an Directly Administered Subprefecture: strategically important, taxing, and difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Da'an Directly Administered Subprefecture: strategically important, taxing, and difficult to administer.

sentences.zh: 省西南二百一十里。

translations.literal: 210 li southwest of the province.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 210 li southwest of the provincial seat.

sentences.zh: 古靺鞨、室韋交界。

translations.literal: Ancient borderland between the Mohe and the Shiwei.
translations.idiomatic: It was the ancient borderland between the Mohe and the Shiwei.

sentences.zh: 明，洮兒河衛及卓兒河地面。

translations.literal: Under the Ming, Ta'erhe Guard and the Zhuo'erhe region.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming it was Ta'erhe Guard and the Zhuo'erhe region.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十年，以札賚特旗莫勒紅岡子墾地置。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year of Guangxu, it was established from reclaimed land at Molehong Gangzi in the Jasak Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 30 it was established from reclaimed land at Molehong Gangzi in the Jasak Banner.

sentences.zh: 北有索倫山脈，蜿蜒數百里，境內東流之水皆導源焉，所謂索倫圍場也。

translations.literal: To the north is the Solon mountain range, winding for several hundred li; all waters within the territory that flow east take their source there — what is called the Solon hunting preserve.
translations.idiomatic: To the north runs the Solon mountain range, winding for several hundred li; all east-flowing waters within the territory rise there — the Solon hunting preserve.

sentences.zh: 東：嫩江自龍江入，南流，匯松花江。

translations.literal: To the east: the Nen River enters from Longjiang, flows south, and joins the Songhua River.
translations.idiomatic: To the east the Nen River enters from Longjiang, flows south, and joins the Songhua River.

sentences.zh: 其左岸為安達、肇州境。

translations.literal: Its left bank is Anda and Zhaozhou territory.
translations.idiomatic: Its left bank lies within Anda and Zhaozhou.

sentences.zh: 北：洮爾河自奉天東鎮入，東流，匯為納藍撒藍池，猶言日月池也，下流入嫩江。

translations.literal: To the north: the Tao'er River enters from Dongzhen in Fengtian, flows east, gathers into Nalan Salan Pool — that is to say, Sun-and-Moon Pool — and flows downstream into the Nen River.
translations.idiomatic: To the north the Tao'er River enters from Dongzhen in Fengtian, flows east, gathers into Nalan Salan Pool — the Sun-and-Moon Pool — and continues downstream into the Nen River.

sentences.zh: 又北瑚爾達河、綽爾河、雅爾河，皆東南流入嫩江。

translations.literal: Farther north, the Hu'erda, Chuo'er, and Ya'er rivers all flow southeast into the Nen River.
translations.idiomatic: Farther north, the Hu'erda, Chuo'er, and Ya'er rivers all flow southeast into the Nen River.

sentences.zh: 雅爾河左岸為龍江境。

translations.literal: The left bank of the Ya'er River is Longjiang territory.
translations.idiomatic: The left bank of the Ya'er River lies within Longjiang.

sentences.zh: 北：塔子城、景星鎮分防二經歷。

translations.literal: To the north: two assistant sub-prefects for frontier defense at Tazicheng and Jingxing Town.
translations.idiomatic: To the north there are two assistant sub-prefects for frontier defense at Tazicheng and Jingxing Town.

sentences.zh: 舊有蒙古站二：自卜魁站起，西至綽爾河，曰哈代罕站，曰綽羅站。

translations.literal: Two old Mongol courier stations: starting from Buque Station west to the Chuo'er River — Hadaikhan Station and Chuo'luo Station.
translations.idiomatic: There were two old Mongol courier stations: from Buque Station west to the Chuo'er River — Hadaikhan and Chuo'luo.

sentences.zh: 又入今奉天之克爾蘇台站。

translations.literal: Then entering K'ersutai Station in present-day Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: The route then enters K'ersutai Station in present-day Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 官商路三：一北出景星鎮赴省城；

translations.literal: Three official and commercial routes: one north from Jingxing Town to the provincial seat;
translations.idiomatic: There are three official and commercial routes: one north from Jingxing Town to the provincial seat;

sentences.zh: 一東渡嫩江接茂興站；

translations.literal: one east across the Nen River connecting with Maoxing Station;
translations.idiomatic: one east across the Nen River to Maoxing Station;

sentences.zh: 一西由二龍鎖口入奉天境，歷鎮東、靖安達洮南。

translations.literal: one west through Erlong Suokou into Fengtian territory, passing Zhendong, Jing'an, and Taonan.
translations.idiomatic: one west through Erlong Suokou into Fengtian, passing Zhendong, Jing'an, and Taonan.

sentences.zh: 嫩江沿岸哈喇和碩，有陸軍退伍兵屯田，一夫授田百畝，以火犁耕種。

translations.literal: Along the Nen River at Halaheshuo, demobilized army veterans farm military colonies; each man is granted 100 mu of land, tilled with fire plows.
translations.idiomatic: Along the Nen at Halaheshuo, demobilized army veterans farm military colonies; each man receives 100 mu of land, worked with fire plows.

sentences.zh: 安達直隸廳：衝，繁，難。

translations.literal: Anda Directly Administered Subprefecture: strategically important, busy, and difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Anda Directly Administered Subprefecture: strategically important, busy, and difficult to administer.

sentences.zh: 省東南二百八十里。

translations.literal: 280 li southeast of the province.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 280 li southeast of the provincial seat.

sentences.zh: 諳達，蒙古官名，無正譯。

translations.literal: Anda is a Mongol official title; there is no standard translation.
translations.idiomatic: Anda is a Mongol official title for which there is no standard translation.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十二年，以杜爾伯特旗墾地置，又分省屬墾地益之。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year of Guangxu, it was established from reclaimed land in the Dorbod Banner, and provincial reclaimed land was further allotted to enlarge it.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 32 it was established from reclaimed land in the Dorbod Banner, then enlarged with provincial reclaimed land.

sentences.zh: 西：嫩江自龍江入，南流入肇州。

translations.literal: To the west: the Nen River enters from Longjiang and flows south into Zhaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: To the west the Nen River enters from Longjiang and flows south into Zhaozhou.

sentences.zh: 北：九道溝水，西流與龍江分界，屈南入境，匯為納赫爾泊，西南：烏克吐泊，下流入嫩江。

translations.literal: To the north: Jiudao Channel water flows west and forms the boundary with Longjiang, turns south and enters the territory, gathers into Nahe'er Lake; to the southwest: Wuketu Lake; downstream they enter the Nen River.
translations.idiomatic: To the north, Jiudao Channel water flows west along the Longjiang border, turns south into the territory, and gathers into Nahe'er Lake; to the southwest lies Wuketu Lake; both flow downstream into the Nen River.

sentences.zh: 南：青肯泊，泊形如環，中有灘地，半隸肇州。

translations.literal: To the south: Qingken Lake, ring-shaped, with sandbanks within; half belongs to Zhaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: To the south lies Qingken Lake, ring-shaped with sandbanks within; half of it belongs to Zhaozhou.

sentences.zh: 放墾區域，大都在嫩江東岸及東南北三面沿邊，中部平原無河流，間有積潦，土含咸質，不宜種植。

translations.literal: The land opened for reclamation lies mostly along the east bank of the Nen River and along the eastern, southern, and northern borders; the central plain has no rivers, occasional standing water, soil containing salt, and is unsuitable for planting.
translations.idiomatic: Land opened for reclamation lies mostly along the east bank of the Nen and along the eastern, southern, and northern borders; the central plain has no rivers, occasional standing water, salty soil, and is unsuitable for cultivation.

sentences.zh: 舊設站三：自龍江之特木德赫站南至廳屬之溫托歡，又南至多耐，又南至他拉哈，又南入肇州。

translations.literal: Three old stations were established: from Temudehe Station in Longjiang south to Wentuhuan in the subprefecture, then south to Duonai, then south to Talaha, then south into Zhaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Three old stations were established: from Temudehe in Longjiang south to Wentuhuan in the subprefecture, then south to Duonai and Talaha, then south into Zhaozhou.

sentences.zh: 官商路四：一北由林家店、九道溝赴省；

translations.literal: Four official and commercial routes: one north from Lindianzi and Jiudao'gou to the province;
translations.idiomatic: There are four official and commercial routes: one north from Lindianzi and Jiudao'gou to the provincial seat;

sentences.zh: 一東南入呼蘭，有小林家店文報局；

translations.literal: one southeast into Hulan, with a Xiaolindianzi document relay bureau;
translations.idiomatic: one southeast into Hulan, with a document relay bureau at Xiaolindianzi;

sentences.zh: 一東由長安堡赴青岡；

translations.literal: one east from Chang'anbao to Qinggang;
translations.idiomatic: one east from Chang'anbao to Qinggang;

sentences.zh: 一西越東清鐵路安達站至杜爾伯特貝子府，又西接多耐站。

translations.literal: one west crossing the Chinese Eastern Railway at Anda Station to the Dorbod princely headquarters, then west connecting with Duonai Station.
translations.idiomatic: one west across the Chinese Eastern Railway at Anda Station to the Dorbod princely headquarters, then west to Duonai Station.

sentences.zh: 產鹼，有咸廠二十五處。

translations.literal: It produces alkali; there are twenty-five salt works.
translations.idiomatic: It produces alkali and has twenty-five salt works.

sentences.zh: 西北璫奈屯有鹽灘。

translations.literal: To the northwest at Dangnai settlement there is a salt flat.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest, Dangnai settlement has a salt flat.

sentences.zh: 東清鐵路自龍江入境，斜貫中部，逕廳治西南入肇州。

translations.literal: The Chinese Eastern Railway enters from Longjiang, cuts diagonally through the center, passes southwest of the subprefectural seat, and enters Zhaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Chinese Eastern Railway enters from Longjiang, cuts diagonally through the center, passes southwest of the subprefectural seat, and continues into Zhaozhou.

sentences.zh: 有煙土屯，小河子，喇嘛甸，薩勒圖，安達五車站。

translations.literal: There are five railway stations: Yantutun, Xiaohezi, Lamadian, Saletu, and Anda.
translations.idiomatic: It has five railway stations: Yantutun, Xiaohezi, Lamadian, Saletu, and Anda.

sentences.zh: 林甸縣：光緒三十四年，擬設治林家甸，隸龍江府。

translations.literal: Lindian County: in the thirty-fourth year of Guangxu, its seat was proposed at Linjiadian, subordinate to Longjiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Lindian County: in Guangxu 34 its seat was proposed at Linjiadian, subordinate to Longjiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 在龍江府東南，安達廳西北。

translations.literal: It lies southeast of Longjiang Prefecture and northwest of Anda Subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: It lies southeast of Longjiang Prefecture and northwest of Anda Subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 東清鐵路迤北，當省城東路孔道。

translations.literal: The Chinese Eastern Railway runs northward, situated on the main eastern route to the provincial seat.
translations.idiomatic: The Chinese Eastern Railway runs northward along the main eastern route to the provincial seat.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十三年改訂東清鐵路合同，收回公司射佔地畝，設縣墾闢。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year of Guangxu the Chinese Eastern Railway contract was revised, company-encroached land was recovered, and the county was established for reclamation and development.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 33 the Chinese Eastern Railway contract was revised, encroached company land was recovered, and the county was established for reclamation.

sentences.zh: 西九道溝子、東戚家店，皆東路所經，如臺站然。

translations.literal: Jiudao'gouzi to the west and Qijiadian to the east both lie on the eastern route, like relay stations.
translations.idiomatic: Jiudao'gouzi to the west and Qijiadian to the east both lie on the eastern route, serving like relay stations.

sentences.zh: 由此入呼蘭達興東。

translations.literal: From here one enters Hulan and reaches Xingdong.
translations.idiomatic: From here the route enters Hulan and reaches Xingdong.

sentences.zh: 諾敏縣：光緒三十四年，擬設治隸嫩江府。

translations.literal: Nuomin County: in the thirty-fourth year of Guangxu, its seat was proposed, subordinate to Nenjiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Nuomin County: in Guangxu 34 its seat was proposed, subordinate to Nenjiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 在嫩江府西，諾敏河東岸庫如爾其屯。

translations.literal: It lies west of Nenjiang Prefecture, at Kuru'erqi settlement on the east bank of the Nuomin River.
translations.idiomatic: It lies west of Nenjiang Prefecture at Kuru'erqi on the east bank of the Nuomin River.

sentences.zh: 西岸都克他耳屯有尼爾吉山，諾敏河上游札克奇山西有牧場，沿河有山路出呼倫。

translations.literal: On the west bank at Duketa'er settlement is Ni'erji Mountain; west of Zhakeqi Mountain on the upper Nuomin River there is pastureland, and along the river a mountain route leads out to Hulun.
translations.idiomatic: On the west bank at Duketa'er stands Ni'erji Mountain; west of Zhakeqi Mountain on the upper Nuomin lies pastureland, and a mountain route along the river leads to Hulun.

sentences.zh: 由縣南行，經西布特哈，渡嫩江，達拉哈站。

translations.literal: Traveling south from the county, one passes Western Buteha, crosses the Nen River, and reaches Talaha Station.
translations.idiomatic: South from the county, the route passes Western Buteha, crosses the Nen River, and reaches Talaha Station.

sentences.zh: 通北縣：光緒三十四年，擬設治海倫府北，通肯河北、胡裕爾河南。

translations.literal: Tongbei County: in the thirty-fourth year of Guangxu, its seat was proposed north of Hailun Prefecture, between the Tongken River to the north and the Huyu'er River to the south.
translations.idiomatic: Tongbei County: in Guangxu 34 its seat was proposed north of Hailun Prefecture, between the Tongken River to the north and the Huyu'er River to the south.

sentences.zh: 西：七道溝自胡裕爾河分出，南注通肯河，東至內興安嶺麓，與興東道龍門鎮界，北接訥河，即海佈道所出。

translations.literal: To the west: Qidao Channel branches from the Huyu'er River, flows south into the Tongken River, and east reaches the foot of the Inner Khingan Range, bordering Longmen Town in Xingdong Circuit; to the north it adjoins Nehe — this is where the Haibu Route begins.
translations.idiomatic: To the west, Qidao Channel branches from the Huyu'er River, flows south into the Tongken River, and runs east to the foot of the Inner Khingan Range, bordering Longmen Town in Xingdong Circuit; to the north it adjoins Nehe — the starting point of the Haibu Route.

sentences.zh: 通肯河瀕岸多森林，土人呼曰樹川。

translations.literal: Along the banks of the Tongken River there is much forest; locals call it Shuchuan.
translations.idiomatic: The banks of the Tongken River are heavily forested; locals call the area Shuchuan — the Tree River.

sentences.zh: 鐵驪縣：光緒三十四年，擬設治海倫府東南、餘慶東鐵山包。

translations.literal: Tieli County: in the thirty-fourth year of Guangxu, its seat was proposed southeast of Hailun Prefecture, east of Yuqing at Tieshanbao.
translations.idiomatic: Tieli County: in Guangxu 34 its seat was proposed southeast of Hailun Prefecture, east of Yuqing at Tieshanbao.

sentences.zh: 東至金牛山、興東道界。

translations.literal: To the east it reaches Jinniu Mountain and the border with Xingdong Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: To the east it reaches Jinniu Mountain and the Xingdong Circuit border.

sentences.zh: 南大青山，東興鎮界。

translations.literal: To the south, Daqing Mountain; bordering Dongxing Town.
translations.idiomatic: To the south lie Daqing Mountain and the border with Dongxing Town.

sentences.zh: 西，鐵山包河，北，依吉密河，並餘慶縣界。

translations.literal: To the west, the Tieshanbao River; to the north, the Yijimi River — both form the border with Yuqing County.
translations.idiomatic: To the west the Tieshanbao River and to the north the Yijimi River both form the border with Yuqing County.

sentences.zh: 呼蘭河出境東達里代嶺，西入餘慶。

translations.literal: The Hulan River exits the territory east to Lidai Ridge and west enters Yuqing.
translations.idiomatic: The Hulan River leaves the county east toward Lidai Ridge and west into Yuqing.

sentences.zh: 有協領駐河北，管理旗丁屯田。

translations.literal: A company commander is stationed north of the river, administering banner soldiers' military colonies.
translations.idiomatic: A company commander is stationed north of the river to administer banner soldiers' military colonies.

sentences.zh: 以上二縣隸海倫府。

translations.literal: The two counties above are subordinate to Hailun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Both counties are subordinate to Hailun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 布西直隸廳：光緒三十四年，擬設治西布特哈，在省城東北二百八十里嫩江西岸。

translations.literal: Buxi Directly Administered Subprefecture: in the thirty-fourth year of Guangxu, its seat was proposed at Western Buteha, on the west bank of the Nen River 280 li northeast of the provincial seat.
translations.idiomatic: Buxi Directly Administered Subprefecture: in Guangxu 34 its seat was proposed at Western Buteha, on the west bank of the Nen 280 li northeast of the provincial seat.

sentences.zh: 西有內興安嶺，與呼倫分界。

translations.literal: To the west is the Inner Khingan Range, forming the border with Hulun.
translations.idiomatic: To the west the Inner Khingan Range forms the border with Hulun.

sentences.zh: 西南即索倫圍場。

translations.literal: To the southwest is the Solon hunting preserve.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest lies the Solon hunting preserve.

sentences.zh: 西北諾敏河，至廳南入嫩江。

translations.literal: To the northwest is the Nuomin River, which enters the Nen River south of the subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest the Nuomin River flows south of the subprefecture into the Nen River.

sentences.zh: 西有阿倫河、音河、雅爾河，皆東南入龍江。

translations.literal: To the west are the Arun, Yin, and Ya'er rivers, all flowing southeast into Longjiang.
translations.idiomatic: To the west the Arun, Yin, and Ya'er rivers all flow southeast into Longjiang.

sentences.zh: 又西迤南，綽爾河入大賚。

translations.literal: Farther west and south, the Chuo'er River enters Da'an.
translations.idiomatic: Farther west and south, the Chuo'er River flows into Da'an.

sentences.zh: 舊設臺七：自龍江之那希奇台東至廳之木爾楚袞台，又東至赫尼昂阿，又東至和尼，又東至錫伯爾，又東至巴林，又東至嘎爾甘，又東至雅勒伯霍托，又東入呼倫境。

translations.literal: Seven old relay stations were established: from Nashiqi Station in Longjiang east to Mu'erchugun Station in the subprefecture, then east to Henianga, then east to Heni, then east to Xibo'er, then east to Balin, then east to Ga'ergan, then east to Yalebohuotuo, then east entering Hulun territory.
translations.idiomatic: Seven old relay stations were established: from Nashiqi in Longjiang east to Mu'erchugun in the subprefecture, then east through Henianga, Heni, Xibo'er, Balin, Ga'ergan, and Yalebohuotuo, then east into Hulun territory.

sentences.zh: 廳境少平原，森林之利獨饒。

translations.literal: The subprefectural territory has little flat land; forest resources alone are abundant.
translations.idiomatic: The subprefecture has little flat land, but its forest resources are exceptionally rich.

sentences.zh: 有土城，因起伏西去數千里，直至木蘭圍場，又西至歸化城。

translations.literal: There is an earthen wall that, rising and falling, runs west for several thousand li as far as the Mulan hunting preserve, and farther west to Guihua City.
translations.idiomatic: An earthen wall runs west for several thousand li, rising and falling as it goes, as far as the Mulan hunting preserve and on to Guihua City.

sentences.zh: 往時流人亡去不識途，多循此入關，蓋即金源時長城汪古部所居者也。

translations.literal: In former times fugitives who fled not knowing the way often followed this route to enter the pass — presumably the dwelling place of the Ongu tribe along the Jin-dynasty Great Wall.
translations.idiomatic: In former times fugitives who lost their way often followed this route inland — presumably the stretch where the Ongu tribe dwelled along the Jin-dynasty Great Wall.

sentences.zh: 東清鐵路自呼倫鑿興安嶺入境，橫貫中部，入龍江。

translations.literal: The Chinese Eastern Railway enters from Hulun through a tunnel in the Khingan Range, crosses the center horizontally, and enters Longjiang.
translations.idiomatic: The Chinese Eastern Railway enters from Hulun through the Khingan Range, crosses the center, and continues into Longjiang.

sentences.zh: 有興安嶺、博爾多、雅魯、巴里木、哈拉蘇、札蘭屯、成吉思汗七車站。

translations.literal: There are seven railway stations: Xing'anling, Bo'erduo, Yalu, Balimu, Halasu, Zhalantun, and Genghis Khan.
translations.idiomatic: It has seven railway stations: Xing'anling, Bo'erduo, Yalu, Balimu, Halasu, Zhalantun, and Genghis Khan.

sentences.zh: 甘南直隸廳：光緒三十四年，擬設治富拉爾基，在省城西南嫩江西。

translations.literal: Gannan Directly Administered Subprefecture: in the thirty-fourth year of Guangxu, its seat was proposed at Fularji, west of the Nen River southwest of the provincial seat.
translations.idiomatic: Gannan Directly Administered Subprefecture: in Guangxu 34 its seat was proposed at Fularji, west of the Nen southwest of the provincial seat.

sentences.zh: 有雅爾河支津。

translations.literal: It has a branch channel of the Ya'er River.
translations.idiomatic: It has a branch channel of the Ya'er River.

sentences.zh: 北有東清鐵路庫勒站。

translations.literal: To the north is Kule Station on the Chinese Eastern Railway.
translations.idiomatic: To the north lies Kule Station on the Chinese Eastern Railway.

sentences.zh: 由此渡嫩江達昂昂溪。

translations.literal: From here one crosses the Nen River to reach Ang'angxi.
translations.idiomatic: From here one crosses the Nen River to Ang'angxi.

sentences.zh: 富拉爾基屯開闢最先，生聚日繁，蓋鐵路交通之效。

translations.literal: Fularji settlement was opened earliest; population and prosperity daily increase — the effect of railway transport.
translations.idiomatic: Fularji was opened earliest and its population grows daily — the effect of railway access.

sentences.zh: 武興直隸廳：光緒三十四年，擬設治多耐站，在省城南二百零五里，嫩江東路四五里，與溫托歡、他拉哈兩站首尾相接。

translations.literal: Wuxing Directly Administered Subprefecture: in the thirty-fourth year of Guangxu, its seat was proposed at Duonai Station, 205 li south of the provincial seat, four or five li east of the eastern Nen route, adjoining head to tail with Wentuhuan and Talaha stations.
translations.idiomatic: Wuxing Directly Administered Subprefecture: in Guangxu 34 its seat was proposed at Duonai Station, 205 li south of the provincial seat and four or five li east of the eastern Nen route, adjoining Wentuhuan and Talaha stations end to end.

sentences.zh: 南北長，東西窄，成一半規長梭形。

translations.literal: Long north to south and narrow east to west, forming a semicircular elongated shuttle shape.
translations.idiomatic: Long north to south and narrow east to west, it forms a semicircular elongated shuttle shape.

sentences.zh: 向為杜爾伯特旗境。

translations.literal: Formerly it was Dorbod Banner territory.
translations.idiomatic: It was formerly Dorbod Banner territory.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十二年，設局放荒五萬六千四百餘晌。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year of Guangxu, an office was established to open 56,400-odd shang of wasteland.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 32 an office opened more than 56,400 shang of wasteland for settlement.

sentences.zh: 呼瑪直隸廳：光緒三十四年，擬設治西爾根卡倫。

translations.literal: Huma Directly Administered Subprefecture: in the thirty-fourth year of Guangxu, its seat was proposed at Xi'ergen karun outpost.
translations.idiomatic: Huma Directly Administered Subprefecture: in Guangxu 34 its seat was proposed at the Xi'ergen karun outpost.

sentences.zh: 宣統二年，試辦設治，移呼瑪爾河口北岸，隸璦琿道，在道治北五百餘里。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuantong, a trial establishment of administration was undertaken, moved to the north bank of the Humar River mouth, subordinate to Aigun Circuit, more than 500 li north of the circuit seat.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 2 a trial seat was established on the north bank of the Humar River mouth, subordinate to Aigun Circuit and more than 500 li north of the circuit seat.

sentences.zh: 東：黑龍江。

translations.literal: To the east: the Heilongjiang River.
translations.idiomatic: To the east lies the Heilongjiang River.

sentences.zh: 呼瑪爾河出伊勒呼里山，內興安山脈向北行者也。

translations.literal: The Humar River rises from Yilehuli Mountain, the northward-running branch of the Inner Khingan Range.
translations.idiomatic: The Humar River rises from Yilehuli Mountain, the northward branch of the Inner Khingan Range.

sentences.zh: 東行者伊勒呼里阿林，四源，合東窩集、倭勒克、庫勒都里、綽羅呼爾吉、布列斯，屈南，右受札克達奇河，又東入黑龍江。

translations.literal: The east-running Yilehuli Range has four sources; they join Dongwoji, Wo'leke, Kuleduli, Chualohu'erji, and Buliesi, turn south, receive on the right the Zhakdaqi River, and farther east enter the Heilongjiang River.
translations.idiomatic: The east-running Yilehuli Range has four sources; they merge with Dongwoji, Wo'leke, Kuleduli, Chualohu'erji, and Buliesi, turn south, receive the Zhakdaqi River on the right, and flow east into the Heilongjiang River.

sentences.zh: 黑龍江東流，逕安羅卡倫北，屈南流，下至呼瑪爾河口。

translations.literal: The Heilongjiang River flows east, passes north of Anluo karun outpost, turns south, and descends to the Humar River mouth.
translations.idiomatic: The Heilongjiang flows east past Anluo karun outpost, turns south, and descends to the Humar River mouth.

sentences.zh: 沿西岸設卡倫六：曰依西肯，曰倭西們，曰安干，曰察哈彥，曰望哈達，曰呼瑪爾。

translations.literal: Six karun outposts are established along the west bank: Yixiken, Wo'ximen, Angan, Chahayan, Wanghada, and Humar.
translations.idiomatic: Six karun outposts line the west bank: Yixiken, Wo'ximen, Angan, Chahayan, Wanghada, and Humar.

sentences.zh: 下游接西爾根卡倫。

translations.literal: Downstream it connects with Xi'ergen karun outpost.
translations.idiomatic: Downstream it connects with the Xi'ergen karun outpost.

sentences.zh: 屬黑河府。

translations.literal: It belongs to Heihe Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: It belongs to Heihe Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 瀕臨河口駐協領，統鄂倫春人。

translations.literal: A company commander is stationed at the river mouth, overseeing the Oroqen people.
translations.idiomatic: A company commander is stationed at the river mouth to oversee the Oroqen people.

sentences.zh: 漠河直隸廳：光緒三十四年，擬設治漠河，隸璦琿道。

translations.literal: Mohe Directly Administered Subprefecture: in the thirty-fourth year of Guangxu, its seat was proposed at Mohe, subordinate to Aigun Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Mohe Directly Administered Subprefecture: in Guangxu 34 its seat was proposed at Mohe, subordinate to Aigun Circuit.

sentences.zh: 在道治西北千餘里。

translations.literal: It lies more than 1,000 li northwest of the circuit seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lies more than 1,000 li northwest of the circuit seat.

sentences.zh: 漠河出治雞察山，東北入黑龍江。

translations.literal: The Mohe River rises from Zhijicha Mountain and flows northeast into the Heilongjiang River.
translations.idiomatic: The Mohe River rises from Zhijicha Mountain and flows northeast into the Heilongjiang River.

sentences.zh: 南額穆爾河，東北流，左受吉里瑪那裡多什都克河，屈東流，右受大札丹庫爾、小札丹庫爾，入黑龍江。

translations.literal: To the south, the Emur River flows northeast, receives on the left the Jilimanaliduoshiduke River, turns east, receives on the right the Da and Xiao Zhadanku'er rivers, and enters the Heilongjiang River.
translations.idiomatic: To the south the Emur River flows northeast, receives the Jilimanaliduoshiduke River on the left, turns east, receives the Da and Xiao Zhadanku'er rivers on the right, and enters the Heilongjiang River.

sentences.zh: 又南旁烏河，東南流，左受巴達吉察，右受札克達奇，屈東北，右受布爾嘎里河、沽里干河，入黑龍江。

translations.literal: Farther south, the Pangwu River flows southeast, receives on the left Badajicha, on the right Zhakdaqi, turns northeast, receives on the right the Bu'ergali and Guligan rivers, and enters the Heilongjiang River.
translations.idiomatic: Farther south the Pangwu River flows southeast, receives Badajicha on the left and Zhakdaqi on the right, turns northeast, receives the Bu'ergali and Guligan rivers on the right, and enters the Heilongjiang River.

sentences.zh: 又南有呼瑪爾河上源，其南為伊勒呼里阿林，乃內興安嶺自西轉東橫幹脈也。

translations.literal: Farther south are the upper sources of the Humar River; south of them is the Yilehuli Range — the main trunk of the Inner Khingan Range turning from west to east.
translations.idiomatic: Farther south lie the upper sources of the Humar River; south of them runs the Yilehuli Range — the main trunk of the Inner Khingan turning from west to east.

sentences.zh: 山南即嫩江源，西有額爾古訥河入黑龍江口，為璦琿與呼倫兩屬交界，即中、俄以江為界之起處。

translations.literal: South of the mountain is the source of the Nen River; to the west the Argun River enters the Heilongjiang River mouth — the border between Aigun and Hulun jurisdictions, that is, where China and Russia take the river as their boundary.
translations.idiomatic: South of the range lies the source of the Nen River; to the west the Argun enters the Heilongjiang — the junction of Aigun and Hulun jurisdictions and the point where the Sino-Russian border begins to follow the river.

sentences.zh: 沿黑龍江南岸設卡倫八：曰洛古河，曰訥欽哈達，曰漠河，即廳治，曰額蘇里，曰巴爾嘎力，曰額穆爾，曰開庫康，曰安羅。

translations.literal: Eight karun outposts are established along the south bank of the Heilongjiang River: Luoguhe, Neqinhada, Mohe — that is, the subprefectural seat — Wusuli, Ba'ergali, Emur, Kaikukang, and Anluo.
translations.idiomatic: Eight karun outposts line the south bank of the Heilongjiang: Luoguhe, Neqinhada, Mohe — the subprefectural seat — Wusuli, Ba'ergali, Emur, Kaikukang, and Anluo.

sentences.zh: 有木廠一處。

translations.literal: There is one lumber mill.
translations.idiomatic: There is one lumber mill.

sentences.zh: 黑龍江由此轉南流，安羅卡倫下游接西岸之依西肯卡倫，屬呼瑪廳。

translations.literal: From here the Heilongjiang River turns south; downstream from Anluo karun outpost it connects with Yixiken karun outpost on the west bank, belonging to Huma Subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: From here the Heilongjiang turns south; downstream from Anluo karun outpost it connects with Yixiken karun outpost on the west bank, within Huma Subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 漠河金礦，光緒十四年經始開採，庚子入於俄，光緒三十二年始行收復。

translations.literal: The Mohe gold mines were first opened in the fourteenth year of Guangxu; in the Gengzi year they fell to Russia; recovery was not undertaken until the thirty-second year of Guangxu.
translations.idiomatic: The Mohe gold mines were first opened in Guangxu 14; they fell to Russia during the Boxer crisis of 1900 and were not recovered until Guangxu 32.

sentences.zh: 漠河為省北屏障，黑龍江轉運專落俄人之手。

translations.literal: Mohe is the northern bulwark of the province; Heilongjiang transport fell entirely into Russian hands.
translations.idiomatic: Mohe is the province's northern bulwark, yet Heilongjiang transport fell entirely into Russian hands.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十四年，議由嫩江之源開闢山道，卒以工費浩繁中止，故礦業衰歇而設治亦難也。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year of Guangxu, a mountain route from the source of the Nen River was proposed, but was abandoned because construction costs were enormous; hence mining declined and establishing administration is also difficult.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 34 a mountain route from the source of the Nen was proposed but abandoned because the cost was prohibitive; mining therefore declined, and establishing a permanent seat remains difficult.

sentences.zh: 室韋直隸廳：光緒三十四年，擬設治吉拉林，隸呼倫道。

translations.literal: Shiwei Directly Administered Subprefecture: in the thirty-fourth year of Guangxu, its seat was proposed at Jilalin, subordinate to the Hulun Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Shiwei Directly Administered Subprefecture: in Guangxu 34 its seat was proposed at Jilalin, subordinate to the Hulun Circuit.

sentences.zh: 在道治北四百餘里，額爾古訥河右岸。

translations.literal: It lay more than 400 li north of the circuit seat, on the right bank of the Argun River.
translations.idiomatic: It lay more than 400 li north of the circuit seat, on the right bank of the Argun River.

sentences.zh: 對岸為俄臥牛、槐敖、洛氣等屯疆域。

translations.literal: The opposite bank was the territory of Russian settlements including Woniu, Huiao, and Luoqi.
translations.idiomatic: The opposite bank was the territory of Russian settlements including Woniu, Huiao, and Luoqi.

sentences.zh: 額爾古訥河自臚濱之阿巴該圖北流，至呼倫之庫克多博，東北流，合根河、特勒布爾、胡裕爾和奇、珠魯克圖即約羅、珠爾格特依、布魯、色木特勒克諸河，皆自東南山來注，此在吉拉林以南者也。

translations.literal: The Argun River flows north from Abaigaitu in Lubin to Kukeduobo in Hulun, then northeast, joining the Gen, Telebu'er, Huyu'erheqi, Zhuluketu (also called Yueluo), Zhuergeteyi, Bulu, and Semutelieke rivers — all joining from the southeast mountains; these lie south of Jilalin.
translations.idiomatic: The Argun River flows north from Abaigaitu in Lubin to Kukeduobo in Hulun, then northeast, joining the Gen, Telebu'er, Huyu'erheqi, Zhuluketu (also called Yueluo), Zhuergeteyi, Bulu, and Semutelieke rivers — all joining from the southeast mountains south of Jilalin.

sentences.zh: 中根河最大，出內興安嶺，西北流，兩岸沃野膏原，為殖民善地。

translations.literal: Among them the Gen River is the largest; it rises in the Inner Khingan Range, flows northwest, and its banks are rich plains — excellent land for colonization.
translations.idiomatic: Of these, the Gen River is the largest; it rises in the Inner Khingan Range and flows northwest through rich plains on both banks — excellent land for colonization.

sentences.zh: 額爾古訥河逕廳治西，又東北流，有哈拉爾即吉拉林河，眉勒喀即尼布楚約內之河、遜河、額爾奇木、畢拉爾、畢拉克產、古爾布奇、吉林子、阿木毗、牛爾、珠爾干、溫諸河，皆自東南山來注。

translations.literal: The Argun River passes west of the subprefecture seat and flows northeast; the Haral (that is, the Jilalin River), Meileka (the river within the Nerchinsk treaty boundary), Xun, E'erqimu, Bilar, Bilakechan, Gu'erbuqi, Jilinzi, Amu'pi, Niu'er, Zhuer'gan, and Wen rivers all join from the southeast mountains.
translations.idiomatic: The Argun River passes west of the subprefecture seat and flows northeast; the Haral (that is, the Jilalin River), Meileka (the river within the Nerchinsk treaty boundary), Xun, E'erqimu, Bilar, Bilakechan, Gu'erbuqi, Jilinzi, Amu'pi, Niu'er, Zhuer'gan, and Wen rivers all join from the southeast mountains.

sentences.zh: 額爾古訥河至是屈西北流，有烏瑪、大吉嘎達、小吉嘎達，復有小河入，皆自東南來注。

translations.literal: At this point the Argun River turns northwest; the Wuma, Da Jigada, and Xiao Jigada rivers and other small streams join from the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: At this point the Argun River turns northwest; the Wuma, Da Jigada, and Xiao Jigada rivers and other small streams join from the southeast.

sentences.zh: 再折而東北流，有伊穆河，復有小河二十餘，皆自東南來注。

translations.literal: It turns northeast again; the Yimu River and more than twenty small streams join from the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: It turns northeast again; the Yimu River and more than twenty small streams join from the southeast.

sentences.zh: 此在吉拉林以北者也。

translations.literal: These lie north of Jilalin.
translations.idiomatic: These lie north of Jilalin.

sentences.zh: 中牛爾河最大，出內興安嶺，河口左右有平地兩區，田土肥美。

translations.literal: Among them the Niu'er River is the largest; it rises in the Inner Khingan Range, and on both sides of its mouth are two areas of level land with rich soil.
translations.idiomatic: Of these, the Niu'er River is the largest; it rises in the Inner Khingan Range, and on both sides of its mouth lie two areas of level land with rich soil.

sentences.zh: 額爾古訥河自受根河、牛爾河，水大而急，直注黑龍江，而吉拉林為適中地，故廳治在焉。

translations.literal: After receiving the Gen and Niu'er rivers, the Argun River becomes large and swift and flows directly into the Heilongjiang; Jilalin is a centrally located place, and therefore the subprefecture seat was placed there.
translations.idiomatic: After receiving the Gen and Niu'er rivers, the Argun River becomes large and swift and flows directly into the Heilongjiang; Jilalin occupies a central location, and therefore the subprefecture seat was placed there.

sentences.zh: 新設防邊卡倫，在境內者十有五，自庫克多博總卡倫以北，曰巴圖爾和碩，曰巴雅斯胡郎圖溫都爾，曰胡裕爾和奇，曰巴彥珠魯克，曰珠爾格特依，曰莫里勒克，曰畢拉爾河，曰牛爾河，曰珠爾干河總卡倫，曰溫河，曰伊穆河，曰奇乾河，曰永安山，曰額勒哈達。

translations.literal: Fifteen newly established frontier-defense karun outposts lay within the territory; north of the chief karun at Kukeduobo were Batu'erheshuo, Bayasihulangtu Wendu'er, Huyu'erheqi, Bayanzhuluke, Zhuergeteyi, Mo'lileke, Bilar River, Niu'er River, the chief karun at Zhuer'gan River, Wen River, Yimu River, Qiqian River, Yong'an Mountain, and E'lehada.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen newly established frontier-defense karun outposts lay within the territory; north of the chief karun at Kukeduobo were Batu'erheshuo, Bayasihulangtu Wendu'er, Huyu'erheqi, Bayanzhuluke, Zhuergeteyi, Mo'lileke, Bilar River, Niu'er River, the chief karun at Zhuer'gan River, Wen River, Yimu River, Qiqian River, Yong'an Mountain, and E'lehada.

sentences.zh: 珠爾干、額勒哈達為鄂倫春與俄人交易之所。

translations.literal: Zhuer'gan and E'lehada were places where the Oroqen traded with Russians.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuer'gan and E'lehada were trading posts where the Oroqen exchanged goods with Russians.

sentences.zh: 尤要道路自吉拉林南至塔爾巴幹達呼山七百餘里，其北至珠爾干河三百五十餘里，則小徑不通車馬。

translations.literal: The most important road ran more than 700 li south from Jilalin to Mount Ta'erbagan Dahu; from there north to the Zhuer'gan River was more than 350 li, where only narrow paths unsuitable for carts and horses existed.
translations.idiomatic: The most important road ran more than 700 li south from Jilalin to Mount Ta'erbagan Dahu; from there north to the Zhuer'gan River was more than 350 li of narrow paths unsuitable for carts and horses.

sentences.zh: 自珠爾干至額爾古訥河口五百五十餘里，則懸崖壁立，非假道於俄，不能飛越。

translations.literal: From Zhuer'gan to the mouth of the Argun River was more than 550 li, where cliffs rose sheer; without taking a route through Russian territory, one could not pass.
translations.idiomatic: From Zhuer'gan to the mouth of the Argun River was more than 550 li of sheer cliffs; without taking a route through Russian territory, the passage could not be made.

sentences.zh: 根河口新立官渡，為華、俄商旅必趨之路。

translations.literal: A newly established official ferry at the mouth of the Gen River was a route that Chinese and Russian merchants had to take.
translations.idiomatic: A newly established official ferry at the mouth of the Gen River was the route that Chinese and Russian merchants had to take.

sentences.zh: 根河上源有道出西布特哈達墨爾根，額爾古訥民船祗達吉拉林，以下溜急，民船可順流而下，不能溯流而上，非輪船不為功。

translations.literal: From the upper reaches of the Gen River a road led from Western Buteha to Mergen; civilian boats on the Argun could reach only Jilalin; below that point the current was swift — civilian boats could go downstream but not upstream, and only steamers could do the work.
translations.idiomatic: From the upper reaches of the Gen River a road led from Western Buteha to Mergen; civilian boats on the Argun could reach only Jilalin; below that point the current was too swift for upstream travel by ordinary boats — only steamers could manage it.

sentences.zh: 冬令，河上可駕駛冰橇，每一日夜行三四百里。

translations.literal: In winter, sleds could be driven on the frozen river, covering three or four hundred li in a day and a night.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, sleds could be driven on the frozen river, covering three or four hundred li in a day and a night.

sentences.zh: 舒都直隸廳：光緒三十四年，擬設治免渡河，隸呼倫道，在道治東二百八十餘里。

translations.literal: Shudu Directly Administered Subprefecture: in the thirty-fourth year of Guangxu, its seat was proposed at Mianduhe, subordinate to the Hulun Circuit, more than 280 li east of the circuit seat.
translations.idiomatic: Shudu Directly Administered Subprefecture: in Guangxu 34 its seat was proposed at Mianduhe, subordinate to the Hulun Circuit, more than 280 li east of the circuit seat.

sentences.zh: 河出阿爾奇山，北合札郭河，入海拉爾河。

translations.literal: The river rises in Mount A'erqi, joins the Zhaguo River to the north, and enters the Hailar River.
translations.idiomatic: The river rises in Mount A'erqi, joins the Zhaguo River to the north, and enters the Hailar River.

sentences.zh: 廳東即內興安嶺。

translations.literal: East of the subprefecture is the Inner Khingan Range.
translations.idiomatic: East of the subprefecture lies the Inner Khingan Range.

sentences.zh: 東清鐵路經廳南，有免渡河車站，由廳境鑿興安山洞入西布特哈境。

translations.literal: The Chinese Eastern Railway passed south of the subprefecture; there was a Mianduhe station, and from subprefecture territory the Xing'an Mountain tunnel was cut into Western Buteha.
translations.idiomatic: The Chinese Eastern Railway passed south of the subprefecture; the Mianduhe station lay on the line, and from subprefecture territory the Xing'an Mountain tunnel was cut into Western Buteha.

sentences.zh: 佛山府：光緒三十四年，擬設治觀音山，隸興東道，在道治北，瀕黑龍江岸。

translations.literal: Foshan Prefecture: in the thirty-fourth year of Guangxu, its seat was proposed at Guanyin Mountain, subordinate to the Xingdong Circuit, north of the circuit seat on the bank of the Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Foshan Prefecture: in Guangxu 34 its seat was proposed at Guanyin Mountain, subordinate to the Xingdong Circuit, north of the circuit seat on the bank of the Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 對岸為俄吉春屯，北有輔河，南有嘉廕河。

translations.literal: The opposite bank was the Russian settlement of Jichun; to the north was the Fu River and to the south the Jiayin River.
translations.idiomatic: The opposite bank was the Russian settlement of Jichun; to the north was the Fu River and to the south the Jiayin River.

sentences.zh: 附府治有小水曰十里河，皆東入黑龍江。

translations.literal: Near the prefectural seat was a small stream called the Shili River; all flowed east into the Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Near the prefectural seat was a small stream called the Shili River; all flowed east into the Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 蘿北直隸廳：光緒三十四年，擬設治托蘿山北，隸興東道，附郭，如璦琿、呼倫兩直隸廳之比。

translations.literal: Luobei Directly Administered Subprefecture: in the thirty-fourth year of Guangxu, its seat was proposed north of Mount Tuoluo, subordinate to the Xingdong Circuit, attached to the circuit seat like Aigun and Hulun subprefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Luobei Directly Administered Subprefecture: in Guangxu 34 its seat was proposed north of Mount Tuoluo, subordinate to the Xingdong Circuit and attached to the circuit seat, like the Aigun and Hulun subprefectures.

sentences.zh: 烏雲直隸廳：光緒三十四年，擬設治烏雲河，隸興東道，在道治西北，瀕黑龍江岸。

translations.literal: Wuyun Directly Administered Subprefecture: in the thirty-fourth year of Guangxu, its seat was proposed at the Wuyun River, subordinate to the Xingdong Circuit, northwest of the circuit seat on the bank of the Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Wuyun Directly Administered Subprefecture: in Guangxu 34 its seat was proposed at the Wuyun River, subordinate to the Xingdong Circuit, northwest of the circuit seat on the bank of the Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 對岸為俄嘎薩得報屯。

translations.literal: The opposite bank was the Russian settlement of Gasadebao.
translations.idiomatic: The opposite bank was the Russian settlement of Gasadebao.

sentences.zh: 烏雲河在廳西，北入黑龍江。

translations.literal: The Wuyun River lay west of the subprefecture and flowed north into the Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: The Wuyun River lay west of the subprefecture and flowed north into the Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 車陸直隸廳：光緒三十四年，擬設治車陸，隸興東道，在道治西北遜河南。

translations.literal: Chelu Directly Administered Subprefecture: in the thirty-fourth year of Guangxu, its seat was proposed at Chelu, subordinate to the Xingdong Circuit, northwest of the circuit seat south of the Xun River.
translations.idiomatic: Chelu Directly Administered Subprefecture: in Guangxu 34 its seat was proposed at Chelu, subordinate to the Xingdong Circuit, northwest of the circuit seat south of the Xun River.

sentences.zh: 原為車勒山卡倫，音轉為車陸。

translations.literal: It was originally the Chele Mountain karun outpost, the name transformed in pronunciation to Chelu.
translations.idiomatic: It was originally the Chele Mountain karun outpost, the name transformed in pronunciation to Chelu.

sentences.zh: 東臨黑龍江，對岸為俄吉滿屯。

translations.literal: It bordered the Heilongjiang to the east; the opposite bank was the Russian settlement of Jiman.
translations.idiomatic: It bordered the Heilongjiang to the east; the opposite bank was the Russian settlement of Jiman.

sentences.zh: 南科爾芬河，東北流入黑龍江。

translations.literal: To the south was the Kuo'erfen River, which flowed northeast into the Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: To the south was the Kuo'erfen River, which flowed northeast into the Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 春源直隸廳：光緒三十四年，擬設治伊春呼蘭河源，隸興東道，在道治西南。

translations.literal: Chunyuan Directly Administered Subprefecture: in the thirty-fourth year of Guangxu, its seat was proposed at the source of the Yichun and Hulan rivers, subordinate to the Xingdong Circuit, southwest of the circuit seat.
translations.idiomatic: Chunyuan Directly Administered Subprefecture: in Guangxu 34 its seat was proposed at the source of the Yichun and Hulan rivers, subordinate to the Xingdong Circuit, southwest of the circuit seat.

sentences.zh: 西有布倫山，伊春河出，東流入湯旺河。

translations.literal: To the west was Mount Bulun; the Yichun River rose there and flowed east into the Tangwang River.
translations.idiomatic: To the west was Mount Bulun; the Yichun River rose there and flowed east into the Tangwang River.

sentences.zh: 布倫山西麓即呼蘭河源。

translations.literal: The western foothills of Mount Bulun were the source of the Hulan River.
translations.idiomatic: The western foothills of Mount Bulun were the source of the Hulan River.

sentences.zh: 南札里河，東流，左合黃泥河、報達河，入湯旺河；

translations.literal: To the south, the Zhali River flowed east, joined the Huangni and Baoda rivers on the left, and entered the Tangwang River;
translations.idiomatic: To the south, the Zhali River flowed east, joined the Huangni and Baoda rivers on the left, and entered the Tangwang River;

sentences.zh: 又南巴蘭河源在焉。

translations.literal: Farther south was the source of the Balan River.
translations.idiomatic: Farther south lay the source of the Balan River.

sentences.zh: 鶴岡縣：，擬設治鶴立岡，隸興東道，在湯原縣北、鶴立河西。

translations.literal: Hegang County: its seat was proposed at Heligang, subordinate to the Xingdong Circuit, north of Tangyuan County and west of the Heli River.
translations.idiomatic: Hegang County: its seat was proposed at Heligang, subordinate to the Xingdong Circuit, north of Tangyuan County and west of the Heli River.

sentences.zh: 有興東墾務公司，宣統中擬移駐黑龍、松花兩江匯流處，額勒密河東，地尤沃饒，為全省冠。

translations.literal: There was the Xingdong Reclamation Company; during the Xuantong reign it was proposed to relocate to the confluence of the Heilong and Songhua rivers, east of the E'lemi River — land exceptionally fertile, the finest in the province.
translations.idiomatic: The Xingdong Reclamation Company was established; during the Xuantong reign it was proposed to relocate to the confluence of the Heilong and Songhua rivers, east of the E'lemi River — land of exceptional fertility, the finest in the province.
